verses.fr: Direz-vous en faveur de Dieu ce qui est injuste, Et pour le soutenir alléguerez-vous des faussetés?
verses.am: በውኑ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ሐሰትን ትናገራላችሁን?  ስለ እርሱም ሽንገላን ታወራላችሁን?

verses.en: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
verses.fr: Voulez-vous avoir égard à sa personne? Voulez-vous plaider pour Dieu?
verses.am: ለፊቱስ ታደላላችሁን?  ስለ እግዚአብሔርስ ትከራከራላችሁን?

verses.en: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?
verses.fr: S''il vous sonde, vous approuvera-t-il? Ou le tromperez-vous comme on trompe un homme?
verses.am: ቢመረምራችሁስ መልካም ይሆንልችኋልን?  ወይስ በሰው እንደምትሳለቁ ትሳለቁበታላችሁን?

verses.en: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
verses.fr: Certainement il vous condamnera, Si vous n''agissez en secret que par égard pour sa personne.
verses.am: በስውር ለሰው ፊት ብታደሉ  ዘለፋ ይዘልፋችኋል።

verses.en: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
verses.fr: Sa majesté ne vous épouvantera-t-elle pas? Sa terreur ne tombera-t-elle pas sur vous?
verses.am: ክብሩስ አያስፈራችሁምን?  ግርማውስ አይወድቅባችሁምን?

verses.en: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
verses.fr: Vos sentences sont des sentences de cendre, Vos retranchements sont des retranchements de boue.
verses.am: ምስሌዎቻችሁ የአመድ ምሳሌዎች ናቸው፤  ምሽጎቻችሁ የጭቃ ምሽጎች ናቸው።

verses.en: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.
verses.fr: Taisez-vous, laissez-moi, je veux parler! Il m''en arrivera ce qu''il pourra.
verses.am: ዝም በሉ፥ እናገርም ዘንድ ተዉኝ፤  የሆነው ነገር ይምጣብኝ።

verses.en: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?
verses.fr: Pourquoi saisirais-je ma chair entre les dents? J''exposerai plutôt ma vie.
verses.am: ሥጋዬን በጥርሴ እይዛለሁ፥  ሕይወቴንም በእጄ አኖራለሁ።

verses.en: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
verses.fr: Voici, il me tuera; je n''ai rien à espérer; Mais devant lui je défendrai ma conduite.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ቢገድለኝ ስንኳ እርሱን በትዕግሥት እጠባበቃለሁ፤  ነገር ግን መንገዴን በፊቱ አጸናለሁ።

verses.en: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
verses.fr: Cela même peut servir à mon salut, Car un impie n''ose paraître en sa présence.
verses.am: ዝንጉ ሰው በፊቱ አይገባምና  እርሱ መድኃኒት ይሆንልኛል።

verses.en: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
verses.fr: Ecoutez, écoutez mes paroles, Prêtez l''oreille à ce que je vais dire.
verses.am: ነገሬን ተግታችሁ ስሙ፥  ምስክርነቴንም በጆሮአችሁ አድምጡ።

verses.en: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
verses.fr: Me voici prêt à plaider ma cause; Je sais que j''ai raison.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ሙግቴን አዘጋጅቻለሁ።  እንደምጸድቅም አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
verses.fr: Quelqu''un disputera-t-il contre moi? Alors je me tais, et je veux mourir.
verses.am: ከእኔስ ጋር የሚፋረድ ማን ነው?  አሁን እኔ ዝም ብል እሞታለሁ።

verses.en: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.
verses.fr: Seulement, accorde-moi deux choses Et je ne me cacherai pas loin de ta face:
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሁለት ነገር አታድርግብኝ፤  የዚያን ጊዜ ከፊትህ አልሰወርም፤

verses.en: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
verses.fr: Retire ta main de dessus moi, Et que tes terreurs ne me troublent plus.
verses.am: እጅህን ከእኔ አርቅ፤  ግርማህም አታስደንግጠኝ።

verses.en: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.
verses.fr: Puis appelle, et je répondrai, Ou si je parle, réponds-moi!
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ጥራኝ፥ እኔም እመልስልሃለሁ።  ወይም እኔ ልናገር፥ አንተም መልስልኝ።

verses.en: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
verses.fr: Quel est le nombre de mes iniquités et de mes péchés? Fais-moi connaître mes transgressions et mes péchés.
verses.am: ያለብኝስ በደልና ኃጢአት ምን ያህል ነው?  መተላለፌንና ኃጢአቴን አስታውቀኝ።

verses.en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
verses.fr: Pourquoi caches-tu ton visage, Et me prends-tu pour ton ennemi?
verses.am: ፊትህን ከእኔ የሰወርህ፥  እንደ ጠላትህም የቈጠርኸኝ ስለ ምን ነው?

verses.en: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
verses.fr: Veux-tu frapper une feuille agitée? Veux-tu poursuivre une paille desséchée?
verses.am: የረገፈውን ቅጠል ታስጨንቃለህን?  ወይስ የደረቀውን ዕብቅ ታሳድዳለህን?

verses.en: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
verses.fr: Pourquoi m''infliger d''amères souffrances, Me punir pour des fautes de jeunesse?
verses.am: የመረረ ነገር ጽፈህብኛልና፤  የሕፃንነቴንም ኃጢአት ታወርሰኛለህ።

verses.en: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
verses.fr: Pourquoi mettre mes pieds dans les ceps, Surveiller tous mes mouvements, Tracer une limite à mes pas,
verses.am: እግሬንም በእግር ግንድ አግብተሃል፥  መንገዴንም ሁሉ መርምረሃል፤  የእግሬን ፍለጋ ወስነሃል።

verses.en: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
verses.fr: Quand mon corps tombe en pourriture, Comme un vêtement que dévore la teigne?
verses.am: እኔ እንደሚጠፋ በስባሳ ነገር፥  ብልም እንደሚበላው ልብስ ነኝ።

verses.en: Man that is born of a woman is of few days and full of trouble.
verses.fr: L''homme né de la femme! Sa vie est courte, sans cesse agitée.
verses.am: ከሴት የተወለደ ሰው  የሕይወቱ ዘመን ጥቂት ቀን ነው፥ መከራም ይሞላዋል።

verses.en: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
verses.fr: Il naît, il est coupé comme une fleur; Il fuit et disparaît comme une ombre.
verses.am: እንደ አበባ ይወጣል፥ ይረግፋልም፤  እንደ ጥላም ይሸሻል፥ እርሱም አይጸናም።

verses.en: And doth thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?
verses.fr: Et c''est sur lui que tu as l''oeil ouvert! Et tu me fais aller en justice avec toi!
verses.am: እንደዚህስ ባለ ሰው ላይ ዓይኖችህን ትከፍታለህን?  ከአንተስ ጋር እኔን ወደ ፍርድ ታገባለህን?

verses.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
verses.fr: Comment d''un être souillé sortira-t-il un homme pur? Il n''en peut sortir aucun.
verses.am: ከርኩስ ነገር ንጹሕን ሊያወጣ ማን ይችላል?  አንድ እንኳ የሚችል የለም።

verses.en: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
verses.fr: Si ses jours sont fixés, si tu as compté ses mois, Si tu en as marqué le terme qu''il ne saurait franchir,
verses.am: የሰው ዕድሜ የተወሰነ ነው፥  የወሩም ቍጥር በአንተ ዘንድ ነው፥  እርሱም ሊተላለፈው የማይችለውን ዳርቻ አደረግህለት።

verses.en: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.
verses.fr: Détourne de lui les regards, et donne-lui du relâche, Pour qu''il ait au moins la joie du mercenaire à la fin de sa journée.
verses.am: እንደ ምንደኛ ዕድሜው እስኪፈጸም ድረስ  ያርፍ ዘንድ ከእርሱ ጥቂት ዘወር በል።

verses.en: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
verses.fr: Un arbre a de l''espérance: Quand on le coupe, il repousse, Il produit encore des rejetons;
verses.am: ዛፍ ቢቈረጥ ደግሞ ያቈጠቍጥ ዘንድ፥  ቅርንጫፉም እንዳያልቅ ተስፋ አለው።

verses.en: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;
verses.fr: Quand sa racine a vieilli dans la terre, Quand son tronc meurt dans la poussière,
verses.am: ሥሩም በምድር ውስጥ ቢያረጅ፥  ግንዱም በመሬት ውስጥ ቢሞት፥

verses.en: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.
verses.fr: Il reverdit à l''approche de l''eau, Il pousse des branches comme une jeune plante.
verses.am: ከውኃ ሽታ የተነሣ ያቈጠቍጣል፤  እንደ አትክልት ቅርንጫፍ ያወጣል።

verses.en: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
verses.fr: Mais l''homme meurt, et il perd sa force; L''homme expire, et où est-il?
verses.am: ሰው ግን ይሞትና ይጋደማል፤  ሰውም ነፍሱን ይሰጣል፥ እርሱስ ወዴት አለ?

verses.en: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:
verses.fr: Les eaux des lacs s''évanouissent, Les fleuves tarissent et se dessèchent;
verses.am: ውኃ ከባሕር ውስጥ ያልቃል፤  ወንዙም ያንሳል ይደርቅማል።

verses.en: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
verses.fr: Ainsi l''homme se couche et ne se relèvera plus, Il ne se réveillera pas tant que les cieux subsisteront, Il ne sortira pas de son sommeil.
verses.am: ሰውም ተኝቶ አይነሣም፤  ሰማይ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ አይነቃም፥  ከእንቅልፉም አይነሣም።

verses.en: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!
verses.fr: Oh! si tu voulais me cacher dans le séjour des morts, M''y tenir à couvert jusqu''à ce que ta colère fût passée, Et me fixer un terme auquel tu te souviendras de moi!
verses.am: በሲኦል ውስጥ ምነው በሰወርኸኝ ኖሮ!  ቍጣህ እስኪያልፍ ድረስ በሸሸግኸኝ ኖሮ!  ቀጠሮም አድርገህ ምነው ባሰብኸኝ ኖሮ!

verses.en: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
verses.fr: Si l''homme une fois mort pouvait revivre, J''aurais de l''espoir tout le temps de mes souffrances, Jusqu''à ce que mon état vînt à changer.
verses.am: በውኑ ሰው ከሞተ ተመልሶ ሕያው ይሆናልን?  መለወጤ እስኪመጣ ድረስ፥  የሰልፌን ዘመን ሁሉ በትዕግሥት በተጠባበቅሁ ነበር።

verses.en: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
verses.fr: Tu appellerais alors, et je te répondrais, Tu languirais après l''ouvrage de tes mains.
verses.am: በጠራኸኝና በመለስሁልህ ነበር፤  የእጅህንም ሥራ በተመኘኸው ነበር።

verses.en: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?
verses.fr: Mais aujourd''hui tu comptes mes pas, Tu as l''oeil sur mes péchés;
verses.am: አሁን ግን እርምጃዬን ቈጥረኸዋል፤  ኃጢአቴንም ትጠባበቃለህ።

verses.en: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.
verses.fr: Mes transgressions sont scellées en un faisceau, Et tu imagines des iniquités à ma charge.
verses.am: መተላልፌ በከረጢት ውስጥ ታትሞአል፥  ኃጢአቴንም ለብጠህበታል።

verses.en: And surely the mountains falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.
verses.fr: La montagne s''écroule et périt, Le rocher disparaît de sa place,
verses.am: ተራራ ሲወድቅ ይጠፋል፥  ዓለቱም ከስፍራው ይፈልሳል፤

verses.en: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.
verses.fr: La pierre est broyée par les eaux, Et la terre emportée par leur courant; Ainsi tu détruis l''espérance de l''homme.
verses.am: ውኆች ድንጋዮቹን ይፍቃሉ፤  ፈሳሾቹም የምድሩን አፈር ይወስዳሉ፤  እንዲሁ የሰውን ተስፋ ታጠፋዋለህ።

verses.en: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
verses.fr: Tu es sans cesse à l''assaillir, et il s''en va; Tu le défigures, puis tu le renvoies.
verses.am: ለዘላለም ታሸንፈዋለህ፥ እርሱም ያልፋል፤  ፊቱን ትለውጣለህ፥ እርሱንም ትሰድደዋለህ።

verses.en: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
verses.fr: Que ses fils soient honorés, il n''en sait rien; Qu''ils soient dans l''abaissement, il l''ignore.
verses.am: ልጆቹ ቢከብሩ አያውቅም፤  ቢዋረዱም አያይም።

verses.en: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.
verses.fr: C''est pour lui seul qu''il éprouve de la douleur en son corps, C''est pour lui seul qu''il ressent de la tristesse en son âme.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የገዛ ሥጋው ሕመም ብቻ ይሰማዋል፥  ለራሱም ብቻ ያለቅሳል። ች

verses.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
verses.fr: Eliphaz de Théman prit la parole et dit:
verses.am: ቴማናዊውም ኤልፋዝ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
verses.fr: Le sage répond-il par un vain savoir? Se gonfle-t-il la poitrine du vent d''orient?
verses.am: በውኑ ጠቢብ ሰው እንደ ንፋስ በሆነ እውቀት ይመልሳልን?  በሆዱስ የምሥራቅን ነፋስ ይሞላልን?

verses.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
verses.fr: Est-ce par d''inutiles propos qu''il se défend? Est-ce par des discours qui ne servent à rien?
verses.am: ከማይረባ ነገር፥  ወይስ ከማይጠቅም ንግግር ጋር ይዋቀሳልን?

verses.en: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.
verses.fr: Toi, tu détruis même la crainte de Dieu, Tu anéantis tout mouvement de piété devant Dieu.
verses.am: አንተም እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ታፈርሳለህ፤  በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አምልኮን ታስቀራለህ።

verses.en: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
verses.fr: Ton iniquité dirige ta bouche, Et tu prends le langage des hommes rusés.
verses.am: በደልህ አፍህን ያስተምረዋል፥  የተንኰለኞችንም አንደበት ትመርጣለህ።

verses.en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas moi, c''est ta bouche qui te condamne. Ce sont tes lèvres qui déposent contre toi.
verses.am: የሚፈርድብህ አፍህ ነው እንጂ እኔ አይደለሁም።  ከንፈሮችህም ይመሰክሩብሃል።

verses.en: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?
verses.fr: Es-tu né le premier des hommes? As-tu été enfanté avant les collines?
verses.am: በውኑ መጀመሪያ የተወለድህ ሰው አንተ ነህን?  ወይስ ከተራሮች በፊት ተፀነስህን?

verses.en: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
verses.fr: As-tu reçu les confidences de Dieu? As-tu dérobé la sagesse à ton profit?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንስ ምሥጢር ሰምተሃልን?  ወይስ ጥበብን ለብቻህ አድርገሃልን?

verses.en: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?
verses.fr: Que sais-tu que nous ne sachions pas? Quelle connaissance as-tu que nous n''ayons pas?
verses.am: እኛ የማናውቀውን አንተ የምታወቀው ምንድር ነው?  ከእኛ ዘንድስ የሌለው የምታስተውለው ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.
verses.fr: Il y a parmi nous des cheveux blancs, des vieillards, Plus riches de jours que ton père.
verses.am: በዕድሜ ከአባትህ የሚበልጡ  ሽበትም ያላቸው ሽማግሌዎችም ከእኛ ጋር አሉ።

verses.en: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?
verses.fr: Tiens-tu pour peu de chose les consolations de Dieu, Et les paroles qui doucement se font entendre à toi?...
verses.am: በውኑ የእግዚአብሔር ማጽናናት፥  በየውሃትም የተነገረህ ቃል ጥቂት ነውን?

verses.en: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,
verses.fr: Où ton coeur t''entraîne-t-il, Et que signifie ce roulement de tes yeux?
verses.am: ልብህስ ለምን ይወስድሃል?  ዓይኖችህስ ለምን ይገለምጣሉ?

verses.en: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?
verses.fr: Quoi! c''est contre Dieu que tu tournes ta colère Et que ta bouche exhale de pareils discours!
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ላይ መንፈስህን እስከ ማንሣት ደርሰህ፤  ይህንም ቃል ከአፍህ እስከ ማውጣት ደርሰህ።

verses.en: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.fr: Qu''est-ce que l''homme, pour qu''il soit pur? Celui qui est né de la femme peut-il être juste?
verses.am: ንጹሕ ይሆን ዘንድ ሰው ምንድር ነው?  ጻድቅስ ይሆን ዘንድ ከሴት የተወለደ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
verses.fr: Si Dieu n''a pas confiance en ses saints, Si les cieux ne sont pas purs devant lui,
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በቅዱሳኑ ስንኳ አይታመንም፤  ሰማያትም በፊቱ ንጹሐን አይደሉም።

verses.en: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?
verses.fr: Combien moins l''être abominable et pervers, L''homme qui boit l''iniquité comme l''eau!
verses.am: ይልቁንስ አስጸያፊና የረከሰ፥  ኃጢአትንም እንደ ውኃ የሚጠጣ ሰው ምንኛ ያንስ?

verses.en: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
verses.fr: Je vais te parler, écoute-moi! Je raconterai ce que j''ai vu,
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም እንግዳ ያልገባባቸው ጠቢባን።  ከአባቶቻቸው ተቀብለው የተናገሩትን ያልሸሸጉትንም፥  እገልጥልሃለሁ፥ ስማኝ፤ ያየሁትንም እነግርሃለሁ።

verses.en: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:
verses.fr: Ce que les sages ont fait connaître, Ce qu''ils ont révélé, l''ayant appris de leurs pères.
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም እንግዳ ያልገባባቸው ጠቢባን።  ከአባቶቻቸው ተቀብለው የተናገሩትን ያልሸሸጉትንም፥  እገልጥልሃለሁ፥ ስማኝ፤ ያየሁትንም እነግርሃለሁ።

verses.en: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.
verses.fr: A eux seuls appartenait le pays, Et parmi eux nul étranger n''était encore venu.
verses.am: ክፉ ሰው ዕድሜውን ሙሉ፥  ከግፈኛ በተመደቡለት በዓመታት ሁሉ በሕመም ይጣጣራል።

verses.en: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
verses.fr: Le méchant passe dans l''angoisse tous les jours de sa vie, Toutes les années qui sont le partage de l''impie.
verses.am: የሚያስደነግጥ ድምፅ በጆሮው ነው፤  በደኅንነቱም ሳለ ቀማኛ ይመጣበታል።

verses.en: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
verses.fr: La voix de la terreur retentit à ses oreilles; Au sein de la paix, le dévastateur va fondre sur lui;
verses.am: ከጨለማ ተመልሶ እንዲወጣ አያምንም፥  ሰይፍም ይሸምቅበታል።

verses.en: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
verses.fr: Il n''espère pas échapper aux ténèbres, Il voit l''épée qui le menace;
verses.am: ተቅበዝብዞም። ወዴት አለ? እያለ እንጀራ ይለምናል፤  የጨለማ ቀን እንደ ቀረበበት ያውቃል።

verses.en: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.fr: Il court çà et là pour chercher du pain, Il sait que le jour des ténèbres l''attend.
verses.am: መከራና ጭንቀት ያስፈራሩታል፤  ለሰልፍ እንደ ተዘጋጀ ንጉሥ ያሸንፉታል፤

verses.en: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.fr: La détresse et l''angoisse l''épouvantent, Elles l''assaillent comme un roi prêt à combattre;
verses.am: እጁን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ዘርግቶአልና፥  ሁሉንም በሚችል አምላክ ላይ ደፍሮአልና፥

verses.en: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
verses.fr: Car il a levé la main contre Dieu, Il a bravé le Tout-Puissant,
verses.am: በደንዳና አንገቱና በወፍራሙ በጋሻው  ጕብጕብ እየሠገገ ይመጣበታልና፥

verses.en: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
verses.fr: Il a eu l''audace de courir à lui Sous le dos épais de ses boucliers.
verses.am: በስብም ፊቱን ከድኖአልና፥  ስቡንም በወገቡ ላይ አድርጓልና፥

verses.en: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.
verses.fr: Il avait le visage couvert de graisse, Les flancs chargés d''embonpoint;
verses.am: በተፈቱም ከተሞች ውስጥ፥  ሰውም በሌለባቸው፥  ክምር ለመሆን በተመደቡ ቤቶች ውስጥ ተቀምጦአልና

verses.en: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
verses.fr: Et il habite des villes détruites, Des maisons abandonnées, Sur le point de tomber en ruines.
verses.am: ባለጠጋ አይሆንም፥ ሀብቱም አይጸናም፤  ጥላውንም በምድር ላይ አይጥልም፤

verses.en: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
verses.fr: Il ne s''enrichira plus, sa fortune ne se relèvera pas, Sa prospérité ne s''étendra plus sur la terre.
verses.am: ከጨለማ አይወጣም፤  ነበልባሉም ቅርንጫፎቹን ያደርቃቸዋል፥  አበባዎቹም ይረግፋሉ።

verses.en: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
verses.fr: Il ne pourra se dérober aux ténèbres, La flamme consumera ses rejetons, Et Dieu le fera périr par le souffle de sa bouche.
verses.am: ዋጋው ከንቱ ነገር ይሆናልና  ራሱን እያሳተ በከንቱ ነገር አይታመን።

verses.en: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
verses.fr: S''il a confiance dans le mal, il se trompe, Car le mal sera sa récompense.
verses.am: ቀኑ ሳይደርስ ጊዜው ይፈጸማል፥  ቅርንጫፉም አይለመልምም።

verses.en: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.
verses.fr: Elle arrivera avant le terme de ses jours, Et son rameau ne verdira plus.
verses.am: እንደ ወይን ያልበሰለውን ዘለላ ያረግፋል፤  እንደ ወይራ አበባውን ይጥላል።

verses.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
verses.fr: Il sera comme une vigne dépouillée de ses fruits encore verts, Comme un olivier dont on a fait tomber les fleurs.
verses.am: የዝንጉዎች ጉባኤ ሁሉ ለጥፋት ይሆናል፥  የጉቦ ተቀባዮችንም ድንኳን እሳት ትበላለች።

verses.en: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
verses.fr: La maison de l''impie deviendra stérile, Et le feu dévorera la tente de l''homme corrompu.
verses.am: ጉዳትን ይፀንሳሉ፥ በደልንም ይወልዳሉ፥  ሆዳቸውም ተንኰልን ያዘጋጃል።

verses.en: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
verses.fr: Il conçoit le mal et il enfante le mal, Il mûrit dans son sein des fruits qui le trompent.
verses.am: ፤ ጉዳትን ይፀንሳሉ፥ በደልንም ይወልዳሉ፥ ሆዳቸውም ተንኰልን ያዘጋጃል።

verses.en: Then Job answered and said,
verses.fr: Job prit la parole et dit:
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.
verses.fr: J''ai souvent entendu pareilles choses; Vous êtes tous des consolateurs fâcheux.
verses.am: እንደዚህ ያለ ዓይነት ነገር እጅግ ሰማሁ፤  እናንተ ሁላችሁ የምታደክሙ አጽናኞች ናችሁ።

verses.en: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?
verses.fr: Quand finiront ces discours en l''air? Pourquoi cette irritation dans tes réponses?
verses.am: በውኑ ከንቱ ቃል ይፈጸማልን?  ወይስ ትመልስ ዘንድ ያነሣሣህ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.
verses.fr: Moi aussi, je pourrais parler comme vous, Si vous étiez à ma place: Je vous accablerais de paroles, Je secouerais sur vous la tête,
verses.am: እኔ ደግሞ እንደ እናንተ እናገር ዘንድ ይቻለኝ ነበር፤  ነፍሳችሁ በነፍሴ ፋንታ ቢሆን ኖሮ፥  እኔ በእናንተ ላይ ቃል ማሳካት፥  ራሴንም በእናንተ ላይ መነቅነቅ በተቻለኝ ነበር።

verses.en: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.
verses.fr: Je vous fortifierais de la bouche, Je remuerais les lèvres pour vous soulager.
verses.am: በአፌም ነገር ባበረታኋችሁ ነበር፤  የከንፈሬን ማጽናናት ባልከለከልሁም ነበር።

verses.en: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?
verses.fr: Si je parle, mes souffrances ne seront point calmées, Si je me tais, en quoi seront-elles moindres?
verses.am: እኔ ብናገር ሕማሜ አይቀነስም፤  ዝምም ብል ከእኔ አይወገድም።

verses.en: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.
verses.fr: Maintenant, hélas! il m''a épuisé... Tu as ravagé toute ma maison;
verses.am: አሁን ግን አድክሞኛል፤  ወገኔንም ሁሉ አፍርሰሃል።

verses.en: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
verses.fr: Tu m''as saisi, pour témoigner contre moi; Ma maigreur se lève, et m''accuse en face.
verses.am: መጨማተሬ ይመሰክርብኛል፤  ክሳቴም ተነሥቶብኛል፤  በፊቴም ይመሰክርብኛል።

verses.en: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
verses.fr: Il me déchire et me poursuit dans sa fureur, Il grince des dents contre moi, Il m''attaque et me perce de son regard.
verses.am: በቍጣው ቀደደኝ፥ እርሱም ጠላኝ፤  ጥርሶቹንም አፋጨብኝ፤  ጠላቴ ዓይኑን አፈጠጠብኝ፤

verses.en: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.
verses.fr: Ils ouvrent la bouche pour me dévorer, Ils m''insultent et me frappent les joues, Ils s''acharnent tous après moi.
verses.am: እነርሱም አፋቸውን ከፈቱብኝ፤  እያላገጡ ጕንጬን ጠፈጠፉኝ፤  በአንድነትም ተሰበሰቡብኝ።

verses.en: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.
verses.fr: Dieu me livre à la merci des impies, Il me précipite entre les mains des méchants.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ለጠማማ ሰው አሳልፎ ሰጠኝ፥  በክፉዎችም እጅ ጣለኝ።

verses.en: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.
verses.fr: J''étais tranquille, et il m''a secoué, Il m''a saisi par la nuque et m''a brisé, Il a tiré sur moi comme à un but.
verses.am: ተዘልዬ ተቀምጬ ነበር፥ እርሱም ሰበረኝ፤  አንገቴንም ይዞ ቀጠቀጠኝ፤  እንደ ዓላማ አድርጎ አቆመኝ።

verses.en: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.
verses.fr: Ses traits m''environnent de toutes parts; Il me perce les reins sans pitié, Il répand ma bile sur la terre.
verses.am: ቀስተኞቹ ከበቡኝ፤  ኵላሊቴንም ቈራረጠ፥ እርሱም አልራራም፤  ሐሞቴን በምድር ላይ አፈሰሰ።

verses.en: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.
verses.fr: Il me fait brèche sur brèche, Il fond sur moi comme un guerrier.
verses.am: በቍስል ላይ ቍስል ጨመረብኝ፤  እንደ ኃያል እየሠገገ ይሮጥብኛል።

verses.en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
verses.fr: J''ai cousu un sac sur ma peau; J''ai roulé ma tête dans la poussière.
verses.am: በቁርበቴ ላይ ማቅ ሰፋሁ፥  ቀንዴንም በመሬት ላይ አኖርሁ።

verses.en: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
verses.fr: Les pleurs ont altéré mon visage; L''ombre de la mort est sur mes paupières.
verses.am: ፊቴ ከልቅሶ የተነሣ ቀላ፤  የሞት ጥላ በዓይኖቼ ቆብ ላይ አለ፤

verses.en: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.
verses.fr: Je n''ai pourtant commis aucune violence, Et ma prière fut toujours pure.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእጄ ዓመፅ የለም፤  ጸሎቴም ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.en: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.
verses.fr: O terre, ne couvre point mon sang, Et que mes cris prennent librement leur essor!
verses.am: ምድር ሆይ፥ ደሜን አትክደኚ፥  ለጩኸቴም ማረፊያ አይሁን።

verses.en: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.
verses.fr: Déjà maintenant, mon témoin est dans le ciel, Mon témoin est dans les lieux élevés.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ ምስክሬ በሰማይ አለ፥  የሚመሰክርልኝም በአርያም ነው።

verses.en: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.
verses.fr: Mes amis se jouent de moi; C''est Dieu que j''implore avec larmes.
verses.am: ጸሎቴ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይድረስ፥  ዓይኔም በፊቱ እንባ ታፍስስ።

verses.en: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!
verses.fr: Puisse-t-il donner à l''homme raison contre Dieu, Et au fils de l''homme contre ses amis!
verses.am: የሰው ልጅ ከባልንጀራው ጋር እንደሚምዋገት፥  ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመምዋገት ምነው በቻለ!

verses.en: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
verses.fr: Car le nombre de mes années touche à son terme, Et je m''en irai par un sentier d''où je ne reviendrai pas.
verses.am: ጥቂቶች ዓመታት ካለፉ በኋላ  እኔ ወደማልመለስበት መንገድ እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.
verses.fr: Mon souffle se perd, Mes jours s''éteignent, Le sépulcre m''attend.
verses.am: መንፈሴ ደከመ፥ ዘመኔ አለቀ፥  መቃብርም ተዘጋጅቶልኛል።

verses.en: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
verses.fr: Je suis environné de moqueurs, Et mon oeil doit contempler leurs insultes.
verses.am: አላጋጮች በእኔ ዘንድ አሉ፥  ዓይኔም በማስቈጣታቸው አደረች።

verses.en: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?
verses.fr: Sois auprès de toi-même ma caution; Autrement, qui répondrait pour moi?
verses.am: አሁንም አንተ መያዣ ሆነህ ተዋሰኝ፤  ከእኔ ጋር አጋና የሚመታ ማን ነው?

verses.en: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.
verses.fr: Car tu as fermé leur coeur à l''intelligence; Aussi ne les laisseras-tu pas triompher.
verses.am: ልባቸውም እንዳያስተውል ከልክለኸዋል፤  ስለዚህ ከፍ ከፍ አታደርጋቸውም።

verses.en: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
verses.fr: On invite ses amis au partage du butin, Et l''on a des enfants dont les yeux se consument.
verses.am: ለብዝበዛ ባልንጀሮቹን አሳልፎ የሚሰጥ ሰው፥  የልጆቹ ዓይን ይጨልማል።

verses.en: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.
verses.fr: Il m''a rendu la fable des peuples, Et ma personne est un objet de mépris.
verses.am: ለሕዝብም ምሳሌ አደረገኝ፤  በፊቱ ላይ ጺቅ እንደሚሉበት ሰው ሆንሁ።

verses.en: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.
verses.fr: Mon oeil est obscurci par la douleur; Tous mes membres sont comme une ombre.
verses.am: ዓይኔም ከኀዘን የተነሣ ፈዘዘች፥  ብልቶቼም ሁሉ እንደ ጥላ ሆኑ።

verses.en: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
verses.fr: Les hommes droits en sont stupéfaits, Et l''innocent se soulève contre l''impie.
verses.am: ቅኖች ሰዎች በዚህ ነገር ይደነቃሉ፥  ንጹሕም በዝንጉው ላይ ይበሳጫል።

verses.en: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
verses.fr: Le juste néanmoins demeure ferme dans sa voie, Celui qui a les mains pures se fortifie de plus en plus.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ግን መንገዱን ያጠነክራል፥  እጁም ንጹሕ የሆነ ሰው ኃይልን እየጨመረ ይሄዳል።

verses.en: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.
verses.fr: Mais vous tous, revenez à vos mêmes discours, Et je ne trouverai pas un sage parmi vous.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እናንተ ሁሉ ተመልሳችሁ ወደ እኔ ኑ፤  በእናንተም ዘንድ ብልሃተኛ አላገኝም።

verses.en: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.
verses.fr: Quoi! mes jours sont passés, mes projets sont anéantis, Les projets qui remplissaient mon coeur...
verses.am: ዕድሜዬ አለፈች፤  አሳቤና የልቤ መሣርያ ተቈረጠ።

verses.en: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.
verses.fr: Et ils prétendent que la nuit c''est le jour, Que la lumière est proche quand les ténèbres sont là!
verses.am: ሌሊቱን ወደ ቀን ይለውጣሉ፤  ብርሃኑም ወደ ጨለማ የቀረበ ይመስላቸዋል።

verses.en: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
verses.fr: C''est le séjour des morts que j''attends pour demeure, C''est dans les ténèbres que je dresserai ma couche;
verses.am: ተስፋ ባደርግ ሲኦል ቤቴ ናት፤  ምንጣፌንም በጨለማ ዘርግቻለሁ።

verses.en: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.
verses.fr: Je crie à la fosse: Tu es mon père! Et aux vers: Vous êtes ma mère et ma soeur!
verses.am: መበስበስን። አንተ አባቴ ነህ፤  ትልንም። አንቺ እናቴ እኅቴም ነሽ ብያለሁ።

verses.en: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
verses.fr: Mon espérance, où donc est-elle? Mon espérance, qui peut la voir?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ተስፋዬ ወዴት ነው?  ተስፋዬንስ የሚያይ ማን ነው?

verses.en: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.
verses.fr: Elle descendra vers les portes du séjour des morts, Quand nous irons ensemble reposer dans la poussière.
verses.am: አብረን በመሬት ውስጥ ስናርፍ፥  ወደ ሲኦል ይወርዳል።

verses.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.fr: Bildad de Schuach prit la parole et dit:
verses.am: ሹሐዊውም በልዳዶስ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.fr: Quand mettrez-vous un terme à ces discours? Ayez de l''intelligence, puis nous parlerons.
verses.am: እስከ መቼ ቃልን ታጠምዳለህ?  አስተውል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ እንናገራለን።

verses.en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?
verses.fr: Pourquoi sommes-nous regardés comme des bêtes? Pourquoi ne sommes-nous à vos yeux que des brutes?
verses.am: ስለ ምንስ እንደ እንስሶች ተቈጠርን?  ስለ ምንስ በዓይንህ ፊት ረከስን?

verses.en: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
verses.fr: O toi qui te déchires dans ta fureur, Faut-il, à cause de toi, que la terre devienne déserte? Faut-il que les rochers disparaissent de leur place?
verses.am: ቍጣ ወርሶሃል፤ አንተስ የሞትህ እንደ ሆነ፥  ምድር ስለ አንተ ባድማ ትሆናለችን?  ወይስ ዓለት ከስፍራው ይነቀላልን?

verses.en: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
verses.fr: La lumière du méchant s''éteindra, Et la flamme qui en jaillit cessera de briller.
verses.am: የኃጢአተኛ መብራት ይጠፋል፥  የእሳቱም ነበልባል ብልጭ አይልም።

verses.en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.
verses.fr: La lumière s''obscurcira sous sa tente, Et sa lampe au-dessus de lui s''éteindra.
verses.am: ብርሃን በድንኳኑ ውስጥ ይጨልማል፥  መብራቱም በላዩ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
verses.fr: Ses pas assurés seront à l''étroit; Malgré ses efforts, il tombera.
verses.am: የኃይሉም እርምጃ ትጠብባለች፥  ምክሩም ትጥለዋለች።

verses.en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.
verses.fr: Car il met les pieds sur un filet, Il marche dans les mailles,
verses.am: እግሩ በወጥመድ ትያዛለች፥  በመረብም ላይ ይሄዳል።

verses.en: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
verses.fr: Il est saisi au piège par le talon, Et le filet s''empare de lui;
verses.am: አሽክላ ሰኰናውን ይይዛል፥  ወስፈንጠርም ይበረታበታል።

verses.en: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
verses.fr: Le cordeau est caché dans la terre, Et la trappe est sur son sentier.
verses.am: በምድር ላይ የሸምቀቆ ገመድ፥  በመንገዱም ላይ ወጥመድ ለእርሱ ተሰውራለች።

verses.en: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
verses.fr: Des terreurs l''assiègent, l''entourent, Le poursuivent par derrière.
verses.am: ድንጋጤ በዙሪያው ታስፈራዋለች፥  በስተ ኋላውም ሆና ታባርራቸዋለች።

verses.en: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.
verses.fr: La faim consume ses forces, La misère est à ses côtés.
verses.am: ኃይሉ በራብ ትደክማለች፥  መቅሠፍትም እስኪሰናከል ተዘጋጅቶለታል።

verses.en: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
verses.fr: Les parties de sa peau sont l''une après l''autre dévorées, Ses membres sont dévorés par le premier-né de la mort.
verses.am: የሰውነቱ ብልቶች ይጠፋሉ፤  የሞትም በኵር ልጅ ብልቶቹን ይበላል።

verses.en: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
verses.fr: Il est arraché de sa tente où il se croyait en sûreté, Il se traîne vers le roi des épouvantements.
verses.am: ከሚታመንበት ድንኳን ይነቀላል፤  ወደ ድንጋጤም ንጉሥ ያስቸኵሉታል።

verses.en: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
verses.fr: Nul des siens n''habite sa tente, Le soufre est répandu sur sa demeure.
verses.am: በድንኳኑ ውስጥ ለእርሱ የማይሆነው ይኖራል፤  በመኖሪያውም ላይ ዲን ይበተናል።

verses.en: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
verses.fr: En bas, ses racines se dessèchent; En haut, ses branches sont coupées.
verses.am: ሥሩ ከበታቹ ይደርቃል፥  ጫፉም ከበላይ ይረግፋል።

verses.en: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
verses.fr: Sa mémoire disparaît de la terre, Son nom n''est plus sur la face des champs.
verses.am: መታሰቢያው ከምድር ላይ ይጠፋል፥  በሜዳም ስም አይቀርለትም።

verses.en: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
verses.fr: Il est poussé de la lumière dans les ténèbres, Il est chassé du monde.
verses.am: ከብርሃን ወደ ጨለማ ያፈልሱታል፥  ከዓለምም ያሳድዱታል።

verses.en: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
verses.fr: Il ne laisse ni descendants ni postérité parmi son peuple, Ni survivant dans les lieux qu''il habitait.
verses.am: ዘርም ትውልድም በሕዝቡ መካከል አይሆንለትም፤  በመኖሪያውም ውስጥ የሚቀመጥ ሰው አይቀርለትም።

verses.en: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.
verses.fr: Les générations à venir seront étonnées de sa ruine, Et la génération présente sera saisie d''effroi.
verses.am: የፊተኞች ሰዎች እንደ ደነገጡ፥  እንዲሁ የኋለኞች ሰዎች ስለ ዘመኑ ይደነቃሉ።

verses.en: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
verses.fr: Point d''autre destinée pour le méchant, Point d''autre sort pour qui ne connaît pas Dieu!
verses.am: በእውነት የኃጢአተኞች ቤት እንዲሁ ናት፥  እግዚአብሔርንም የማያውቅ ሰው ስፍራ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Then Job answered and said,
verses.fr: Job prit la parole et dit:
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
verses.fr: Jusques à quand affligerez-vous mon âme, Et m''écraserez-vous de vos discours?
verses.am: ነፍሴን የምትነዘንዙ፥  በቃልስ የምታደቅቁኝ እስከ መቼ ነው?

verses.en: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.
verses.fr: Voilà dix fois que vous m''outragez; N''avez-vous pas honte de m''étourdir ainsi?
verses.am: ይኸው ስትሰድቡኝ አሥር ጊዜ ነው፤  ስታሻክሩኝም አላፈራችሁም።

verses.en: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
verses.fr: Si réellement j''ai péché, Seul j''en suis responsable.
verses.am: በእውነትም የሳትሁ እንደ ሆነ፥  ስሕተቴ ከእኔ ጋር ትኖራለች።

verses.en: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
verses.fr: Pensez-vous me traiter avec hauteur? Pensez-vous démontrer que je suis coupable?
verses.am: በእውነትም ብትጓደዱብኝ፥  መዋረዴን በእኔ ላይ ብትከራከሩ፥

verses.en: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.
verses.fr: Sachez alors que c''est Dieu qui me poursuit, Et qui m''enveloppe de son filet.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ገለበጠኝ፥  በመረቡም እንደ ከበበኝ እወቁ።

verses.en: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.
verses.fr: Voici, je crie à la violence, et nul ne répond; J''implore justice, et point de justice!
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ስለ ተደረገብኝ ግፍ ብጮኽ ማንም አይመልስልኝም፤  አሰምቼም ብጠራ ፍርድ የለኝም።

verses.en: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
verses.fr: Il m''a fermé toute issue, et je ne puis passer; Il a répandu des ténèbres sur mes sentiers.
verses.am: እንዳላልፍ መንገዴን ዘግቶታል፥  በጎዳናዬም ጨለማ አኑሮበታል።

verses.en: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
verses.fr: Il m''a dépouillé de ma gloire, Il a enlevé la couronne de ma tête.
verses.am: ክብሬን ገፈፈኝ፥  ዘውዴንም ከራሴ ላይ ወሰደ።

verses.en: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
verses.fr: Il m''a brisé de toutes parts, et je m''en vais; Il a arraché mon espérance comme un arbre.
verses.am: በዚህና በዚያም አፈረሰኝ፥ እኔም ሄድሁ፤  ተስፋዬንም እንደ ዛፍ ነቀለው፤

verses.en: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.
verses.fr: Il s''est enflammé de colère contre moi, Il m''a traité comme l''un de ses ennemis.
verses.am: ቍጣውንም አነደደብኝ፥  እንደ ጠላቱም ቈጠረኝ።

verses.en: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
verses.fr: Ses troupes se sont de concert mises en marche, Elles se sont frayé leur chemin jusqu''à moi, Elles ont campées autour de ma tente.
verses.am: ሠራዊቱ አብረው መጡ፥  መንገዳቸውንም በላዬ አዘጋጁ፥  በድንኳኔም ዙሪያ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
verses.fr: Il a éloigné de moi mes frères, Et mes amis se sont détournés de moi;
verses.am: ወንድሞቼን ከእኔ ዘንድ አራቀ፥  የሚያውቁኝም አጥብቀው ተለዩኝ።

verses.en: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
verses.fr: Je suis abandonné de mes proches, Je suis oublié de mes intimes.
verses.am: ዘመዶቼ ተቋረጡ፥  ወዳጆቼም ረሱኝ።

verses.en: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
verses.fr: Je suis un étranger pour mes serviteurs et mes servantes, Je ne suis plus à leurs yeux qu''un inconnu.
verses.am: ቤተ ሰቦቼና ሴቶች ባሪያዎቼ እንደ መጻተኛ ቈጠሩኝ፤  በዓይናቸውም እንደ እንግዳ ሆንሁ።

verses.en: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
verses.fr: J''appelle mon serviteur, et il ne répond pas; Je le supplie de ma bouche, et c''est en vain.
verses.am: ባሪያዬን ብጠራ፥ በአፌም ባቈላምጥ አይመልስልኝም።

verses.en: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's sake of mine own body.
verses.fr: Mon humeur est à charge à ma femme, Et ma plainte aux fils de mes entrailles.
verses.am: ሚስቴ እስትንፋሴን ጠላች፥  የእናቴም ማኅፀን ልጆች ልመናዬን ጠሉ።

verses.en: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
verses.fr: Je suis méprisé même par des enfants; Si je me lève, je reçois leurs insultes.
verses.am: ሕፃናቶች እንኳ አጠቁኝ፤  ብነሣም በእኔ ላይ ይናገራሉ።

verses.en: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
verses.fr: Ceux que j''avais pour confidents m''ont en horreur, Ceux que j''aimais se sont tournés contre moi.
verses.am: አማካሪዎቼ ሁሉ ተጸየፉኝ፤  እኔ የምወድዳቸው በላዬ ተገለበጡ።

verses.en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
verses.fr: Mes os sont attachés à ma peau et à ma chair; Il ne me reste que la peau des dents.
verses.am: አጥንቴ ከቁርበቴና ከሥጋዬ ጋር ተጣበቀ፤  ድድ ብቻ ቀርቶልኝ አመለጥሁ።

verses.en: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.
verses.fr: Ayez pitié, ayez pitié de moi, vous, mes amis! Car la main de Dieu m''a frappé.
verses.am: እናንተ ወዳጆቼ ሆይ፥ ማሩኝ፤  የእግዚአብሔር እጅ መትታኛለችና ማሩኝ።

verses.en: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.fr: Pourquoi me poursuivre comme Dieu me poursuit? Pourquoi vous montrer insatiables de ma chair?
verses.am: ስለ ምን እናንተ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ታሳድዱኛላችሁ?  ከሥጋዬስ ስለ ምን አትጠግቡም?

verses.en: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
verses.fr: Oh! je voudrais que mes paroles fussent écrites, Qu''elles fussent écrites dans un livre;
verses.am: ምነው አሁን ቃሌ ቢጻፍ!  ምነው በመጽሐፍ ውስጥ ቢታተም!

verses.en: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
verses.fr: Je voudrais qu''avec un burin de fer et avec du plomb Elles fussent pour toujours gravées dans le roc...
verses.am: ምነው በብረት ብርና በእርሳስ  በዓለቱ ላይ ለዘላለም ቢቀረጽ!

verses.en: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
verses.fr: Mais je sais que mon rédempteur est vivant, Et qu''il se lèvera le dernier sur la terre.
verses.am: እኔን ግን የሚቤዠኝ ሕያው እንደ ሆነ፥  በመጨረሻም ዘመን በምድር ላይ እንዲቆም፥

verses.en: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:
verses.fr: Quand ma peau sera détruite, il se lèvera; Quand je n''aurai plus de chair, je verrai Dieu.
verses.am: ይህ ቁርበቴም ከጠፋ በኋላ፥  በዚያን ጊዜ ከሥጋዬ ተለይቼ እግዚአብሔርን እንዳይ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.
verses.fr: Je le verrai, et il me sera favorable; Mes yeux le verront, et non ceux d''un autre; Mon âme languit d''attente au dedans de moi.
verses.am: እኔ ራሴ አየዋለሁ፥  ዓይኖቼም ይመለከቱታል፥  ከእኔም ሌላ አይደለም።  ልቤ በመናፈቅ ዝሎአል።

verses.en: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
verses.fr: Vous direz alors: Pourquoi le poursuivions-nous? Car la justice de ma cause sera reconnue.
verses.am: በእውነት። እንዴት እናሳድደዋለን?  የነገሩ ሥር በእርሱ ዘንድ ተገኝቶአል ብትሉ፥

verses.en: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.
verses.fr: Craignez pour vous le glaive: Les châtiments par le glaive sont terribles! Et sachez qu''il y a un jugement.
verses.am: ፍርድ እንዳለ ታውቁ ዘንድ  ቍጣ የሰይፍን ቅጣት ያመጣልና  ከሰይፍ ፍሩ።

verses.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.fr: Tsophar de Naama prit la parole et dit:
verses.am: ናዕማታዊውም ሶፋር መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.
verses.fr: Mes pensées me forcent à répondre, Et mon agitation ne peut se contenir.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በውስጤ ስላለው ችኰላ አሳቤ ትመልስልኛለች።

verses.en: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
verses.fr: J''ai entendu des reproches qui m''outragent; Le souffle de mon intelligence donnera la réplique.
verses.am: የሚያሳፍረኝንም ተግሣጽ ሰምቻለሁ፥  የማስተዋሌም መንፈስ ይመልስልኛል።

verses.en: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
verses.fr: Ne sais-tu pas que, de tout temps, Depuis que l''homme a été placé sur la terre,
verses.am: ሰው በምድር ላይ ከተቀመጠ፥ ከዱሮ ዘመን ጀምሮ፥

verses.en: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
verses.fr: Le triomphe des méchants a été court, Et la joie de l''impie momentanée?
verses.am: የኃጢአተኛ ፉከራ አጭር መሆኑን  የዝንጉዎችም ደስታ ቅጽበት መሆኑን አታውቁምን?

verses.en: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;
verses.fr: Quand il s''élèverait jusqu''aux cieux, Et que sa tête toucherait aux nues,
verses.am: ከፍታው ወደ ሰማይ ቢወጣ፥  ራሱም እስከ ደመና ቢደርስ፥

verses.en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?
verses.fr: Il périra pour toujours comme son ordure, Et ceux qui le voyaient diront: Où est-il?
verses.am: እንደ ፋንድያ ለዘላለም ይጠፋል፤  ያዩትም። ወዴት ነው? ይላሉ።

verses.en: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
verses.fr: Il s''envolera comme un songe, et on ne le trouvera plus; Il disparaîtra comme une vision nocturne;
verses.am: እንደ ሕልም ይበርራል፥ እርሱም አይገኝም፤  እንደ ሌሊትም ራእይ ይሰደዳል።

verses.en: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
verses.fr: L''oeil qui le regardait ne le regardera plus, Le lieu qu''il habitait ne l''apercevra plus.
verses.am: ያየችውም ዓይን ዳግመኛ አታየውም፤  ስፍራውም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይመለከተውም።

verses.en: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
verses.fr: Ses fils seront assaillis par les pauvres, Et ses mains restitueront ce qu''il a pris par violence.
verses.am: ልጆቹ ድሆቹን ያቈላምጣሉ፤  እጁ ሀብቱን ይመልሳል።

verses.en: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
verses.fr: La vigueur de la jeunesse, qui remplissait ses membres, Aura sa couche avec lui dans la poussière.
verses.am: አጥንቶቹ ብላቴንነቱን ሞልተዋል፤  ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ጋር በመሬት ውስጥ ይተኛል።

verses.en: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;
verses.fr: Le mal était doux à sa bouche, Il le cachait sous sa langue,
verses.am: ክፋት በአፉ ውስጥ ቢጣፍጥ፥  ከምላሱም በታች ቢሰውረው፥

verses.en: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
verses.fr: Il le savourait sans l''abandonner, Il le retenait au milieu de son palais;
verses.am: ቢጠብቀውም ባይተወውም፥  በጕሮሮውም ቢይዘው፥

verses.en: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.
verses.fr: Mais sa nourriture se transformera dans ses entrailles, Elle deviendra dans son corps un venin d''aspic.
verses.am: መብሉ በአንጀቱ ውስጥ ይገላበጣል፤  እንደ እፉኝትም ሐሞት በውስጡ ይሆናል።

verses.en: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.
verses.fr: Il a englouti des richesses, il les vomira; Dieu les chassera de son ventre.
verses.am: የዋጠውን ሀብት ይተፋዋል፤  እግዚአብሔርም ከሆዱ ውስጥ ያወጣዋል።

verses.en: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.
verses.fr: Il a sucé du venin d''aspic, La langue de la vipère le tuera.
verses.am: የእፉኝትን መርዝ ይጠባል፤  የእባብም ምላስ ይገድለዋል።

verses.en: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
verses.fr: Il ne reposera plus ses regards sur les ruisseaux, Sur les torrents, sur les fleuves de miel et de lait.
verses.am: የማሩንና የቅቤውን ፈሳሽ  ወንዞቹንም አይመለከትም።

verses.en: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.
verses.fr: Il rendra ce qu''il a gagné, et n''en profitera plus; Il restituera tout ce qu''il a pris, et n''en jouira plus.
verses.am: የድካሙን ፍሬ ሳይውጠው ይመልሰዋል፤  እንደ ንግዱም ትርፍ አይደሰትም።

verses.en: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
verses.fr: Car il a opprimé, délaissé les pauvres, Il a ruiné des maisons et ne les a pas rétablies.
verses.am: ድሀውን አስጨንቆአል፥ ትቶታልም፤  ያልሠራውንም ቤት በዝብዞአል።

verses.en: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
verses.fr: Son avidité n''a point connu de bornes; Mais il ne sauvera pas ce qu''il avait de plus cher.
verses.am: ሆዱ ዕረፍትን አላወቀምና  የወደደው ነገር አላዳነውም።

verses.en: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
verses.fr: Rien n''échappait à sa voracité; Mais son bien-être ne durera pas.
verses.am: እርሱ ከበላ በኋላ ምንም አልተረፈም፤  ስለዚህ በረከቱ አይከናወንለትም።

verses.en: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
verses.fr: Au milieu de l''abondance il sera dans la détresse; La main de tous les misérables se lèvera sur lui.
verses.am: በጠገበ ጊዜ ይጨነቃል፤  የችግረኞችም ሁሉ እጅ ታገኘዋለች።

verses.en: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
verses.fr: Et voici, pour lui remplir le ventre, Dieu enverra sur lui le feu de sa colère, Et le rassasiera par une pluie de traits.
verses.am: ሆዱን ሳያጠግብ  እግዚአብሔር የቍጣውን ትኵሳት ይሰድድበታል፥  ሲበላም ያዘንብበታል።

verses.en: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.
verses.fr: S''il échappe aux armes de fer, L''arc d''airain le transpercera.
verses.am: ከብረት መሣርያም ይሸሻል፥  የናስም ቀስት ይወጋዋል።

verses.en: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.
verses.fr: Il arrache de son corps le trait, Qui étincelle au sortir de ses entrailles, Et il est en proie aux terreurs de la mort.
verses.am: እርሱም ይመዝዘዋል፥ ከሥጋውም ይወጣል፤  ከሐሞቱም ብልጭ ብሎ ይሠርጻል፤  ፍርሃትም ይወድቅበታል።

verses.en: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
verses.fr: Toutes les calamités sont réservées à ses trésors; Il sera consumé par un feu que n''allumera point l''homme, Et ce qui restera dans sa tente en deviendra la pâture.
verses.am: ጨለማ ሁሉ ስለ ከበረው ዕቃ ተዘጋጅቶአል፤  በሰው አፍ እፍ የማትባል እሳት ትበላዋለች፤  በድንኳኑ ውስጥ የቀረው ይጨነቅባታል።

verses.en: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
verses.fr: Les cieux dévoileront son iniquité, Et la terre s''élèvera contre lui.
verses.am: ሰማይ ኃጢአቱን ይገልጥበታል፥  ምድርም ትነሣበታለች።

verses.en: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
verses.fr: Les revenus de sa maison seront emportés, Ils disparaîtront au jour de la colère de Dieu.
verses.am: የቤቱም ባለጠግነት ይሄዳል፤  በቍጣው ቀን እንደ ፈሳሽ ውኃ ያልፋል።

verses.en: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.
verses.fr: Telle est la part que Dieu réserve au méchant, Tel est l''héritage que Dieu lui destine.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የበደለኛ ሰው እድል ፈንታ፥  ከእግዚአብሔርም የተመደበ ርስቱ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: But Job answered and said,
verses.fr: Job prit la parole et dit:
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
verses.fr: Ecoutez, écoutez mes paroles, Donnez-moi seulement cette consolation.
verses.am: ስሙ፥ ቃሌን ስሙ፤  ይህም መጽናናታችሁ ይሁን።

verses.en: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.
verses.fr: Laissez-moi parler, je vous prie; Et, quand j''aurai parlé, tu pourras te moquer.
verses.am: እናገር ዘንድ ተዉኝ፤  ከተናገርሁም በኋላ ተሳለቁ።

verses.en: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?
verses.fr: Est-ce contre un homme que se dirige ma plainte? Et pourquoi mon âme ne serait-elle pas impatiente?
verses.am: በውኑ የኀዘን እንጉርጕሮዬ ለሰው እናገራለሁን?  አለመታገሥ ስለ ምን አይገባኝም?

verses.en: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.
verses.fr: Regardez-moi, soyez étonnés, Et mettez la main sur la bouche.
verses.am: ወደ እኔ ተመልከቱ፥ ተደነቁም፤  እጃችሁንም በአፋችሁ ላይ አኑሩ።

verses.en: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
verses.fr: Quand j''y pense, cela m''épouvante, Et un tremblement saisit mon corps.
verses.am: እኔ ባሰብሁ ቍጥር እጨነቃለሁ፥  ፃዕርም ሥጋዬን ይይዛል።

verses.en: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
verses.fr: Pourquoi les méchants vivent-ils? Pourquoi les voit-on vieillir et accroître leur force?
verses.am: ስለ ምን ኃጢአተኞች በሕይወት ይኖራሉ?  ስለ ምንስ ያረጃሉ? በባለጠግነትስ ስለ ምን ይበረታሉ?

verses.en: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
verses.fr: Leur postérité s''affermit avec eux et en leur présence, Leurs rejetons prospèrent sous leurs yeux.
verses.am: ዘራቸው ከእነርሱ ጋር ጸንቶ ይኖራል፥  ልጆቻቸውም በዓይናቸው ፊት ናቸው።

verses.en: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
verses.fr: Dans leurs maisons règne la paix, sans mélange de crainte; La verge de Dieu ne vient pas les frapper.
verses.am: ቤታቸው ከፍርሃት ወጥቶ የታመነ ነው፥  የእግዚአብሔርም በትር የለባቸውም።

verses.en: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
verses.fr: Leurs taureaux sont vigoureux et féconds, Leurs génisses conçoivent et n''avortent point.
verses.am: ኮርማቸው ይወልዳል፥ ዘሩንም አይጥለውም፤  ላማቸውም ትወልዳለች፥ አትጨነግፍም።

verses.en: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
verses.fr: Ils laissent courir leurs enfants comme des brebis, Et les enfants prennent leurs ébats.
verses.am: ሕፃናቶቻቸውን እንደ መንጋ ያወጣሉ፥  ልጆቻቸውም ይዘፍናሉ።

verses.en: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
verses.fr: Ils chantent au son du tambourin et de la harpe, Ils se réjouissent au son du chalumeau.
verses.am: ከበሮና መሰንቆ ወስደው ይዘምራሉ፥  በእምቢልታ ድምፅ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
verses.fr: Ils passent leurs jours dans le bonheur, Et ils descendent en un instant au séjour des morts.
verses.am: ዕድሜያቸውንም በተድላ ይፈጽማሉ፤  ድንገትም ወደ ሲኦል ይወርዳሉ።

verses.en: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
verses.fr: Ils disaient pourtant à Dieu: Retire-toi de nous; Nous ne voulons pas connaître tes voies.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም። ከእኛ ዘንድ ራቅ፤  መንገድህን እናውቅ ዘንድ አንወድድም።

verses.en: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
verses.fr: Qu''est-ce que le Tout-Puissant, pour que nous le servions? Que gagnerons-nous à lui adresser nos prières?
verses.am: እናመልከውስ ዘንድ ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ ማን ነው?  ወይስ ወደ እርሱ ብንጸልይ ምን ይጠቅመናል? ይላሉ።

verses.en: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.fr: Quoi donc! ne sont-ils pas en possession du bonheur? -Loin de moi le conseil des méchants!
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ሀብታቸው በእጃቸው ውስጥ አይደለምን?  የኃጥአን ምክር ከእኔ ዘንድ የራቀች ናት።

verses.en: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.
verses.fr: Mais arrive-t-il souvent que leur lampe s''éteigne, Que la misère fonde sur eux, Que Dieu leur distribue leur part dans sa colère,
verses.am: የኃጥአን መብራት የጠፋው፥  መቅሠፍትም የመጣባቸው፥  እግዚአብሔርም በቍጣው መከራ የከፈላቸው፥

verses.en: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.
verses.fr: Qu''ils soient comme la paille emportée par le vent, Comme la balle enlevée par le tourbillon?
verses.am: በነፋስ ፊት እንደ ገለባ፥  ዐውሎ ነፋስም እንደሚወስደው ትቢያ የሆኑ ስንት ጊዜ ነው?

verses.en: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.
verses.fr: Est-ce pour les fils que Dieu réserve le châtiment du père? Mais c''est lui que Dieu devrait punir, pour qu''il le sente;
verses.am: እናንተ። እግዚአብሔር በደላቸውን ለልጆቻቸው ይጠብቃል ብላችኋል።  እነርሱ ያውቁ ዘንድ ፍዳን ለራሳቸው ይክፈል።

verses.en: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.fr: C''est lui qui devrait contempler sa propre ruine, C''est lui qui devrait boire la colère du Tout-Puissant.
verses.am: ዓይኖቻቸው ጥፋታቸውን ይዩ፥  ሁሉን ከሚችል አምላክ ቍጣ ይጠጡ።

verses.en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
verses.fr: Car, que lui importe sa maison après lui, Quand le nombre de ses mois est achevé?
verses.am: የወራታቸውስ ቍጥር ቢቈረጥ፥  ከእነርሱ በኋላ የቤታቸው ደስታ ምን ይሆናቸዋል?

verses.en: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.
verses.fr: Est-ce à Dieu qu''on donnera de la science, A lui qui gouverne les esprits célestes?
verses.am: ከፍ ከፍ ባሉትስ ላይ ለሚፈርድ ለእግዚአብሔር  በውኑ ሰው እውቀትን ያስተምራልን?

verses.en: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
verses.fr: L''un meurt au sein du bien-être, De la paix et du bonheur,
verses.am: አንድ ሰው በሰላም ተዘልሎ ሲቀመጥ  በሙሉ ኃይሉ ሳለ ይሞታል።

verses.en: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.
verses.fr: Les flancs chargés de graisse Et la moelle des os remplie de sève;
verses.am: በአንጀቱ ውስጥ ስብ ሞልቶአል፥  የአጥንቶቹም ቅልጥም ረጥቦአል።

verses.en: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.
verses.fr: L''autre meurt, l''amertume dans l''âme, Sans avoir joui d''aucun bien.
verses.am: ሌላውም ሰው መልካምን ነገር ከቶ ሳይቀምስ  በተመረረች ነፍስ ይሞታል።

verses.en: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.
verses.fr: Et tous deux se couchent dans la poussière, Tous deux deviennent la pâture des vers.
verses.am: በአፈር ውስጥ በአንድ ላይ ይተኛሉ፥  ትልም ይከድናቸዋል።

verses.en: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.
verses.fr: Je sais bien quelles sont vos pensées, Quels jugements iniques vous portez sur moi.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ አሳባችሁን፥  የመከራችሁብኝንም ክፉ ምክር አውቄዋለሁ።

verses.en: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?
verses.fr: Vous dites: Où est la maison de l''homme puissant? Où est la tente qu''habitaient les impies?
verses.am: እናንተ። የከበርቴው ቤት የት ነው?  ኃጢአተኛውም ያደረበት ድንኳን የት ነው? ብላችኋል።

verses.en: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
verses.fr: Mais quoi! n''avez-vous point interrogé les voyageurs, Et voulez-vous méconnaître ce qu''ils prouvent?
verses.am: መንገድ አላፊዎችን አልጠየቃችሁምን?  ምልክታቸውን አታውቁምን?

verses.en: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.
verses.fr: Au jour du malheur, le méchant est épargné; Au jour de la colère, il échappe.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛው በመቅሠፍት ቀን እንደ ተጠበቀ፥  በቍጣው ቀን እንደሚድን።

verses.en: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?
verses.fr: Qui lui reproche en face sa conduite? Qui lui rend ce qu''il a fait?
verses.am: መንገዱን በፊቱ የሚናገር ማን ነው?  የሠራውንስ የሚመልስበት ማን ነው?

verses.en: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
verses.fr: Il est porté dans un sépulcre, Et il veille encore sur sa tombe.
verses.am: እርሱን ግን ወደ መቃብር ይሸከሙታል፥  ሰዎቹም በመቃብሩ ላይ ይጠብቃሉ።

verses.en: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.
verses.fr: Les mottes de la vallée lui sont légères; Et tous après lui suivront la même voie, Comme une multitude l''a déjà suivie.
verses.am: የሸለቆው ጓል ይጣፍጥለታል፤  በኋላውም ሰው ሁሉ ይሳባል፥  በፊቱም ቍጥር የሌለው ጉባኤ አለ።

verses.en: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?
verses.fr: Pourquoi donc m''offrir de vaines consolations? Ce qui reste de vos réponses n''est que perfidie.
verses.am: የምትመልሱልኝ ውስልትና ነውና  በከንቱ እንዴት ታጽናኑኛላችሁ?

verses.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.fr: Eliphaz de Théman prit la parole et dit:
verses.am: ቴማናዊውም ኤልፋዝ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
verses.fr: Un homme peut-il être utile à Dieu? Non; le sage n''est utile qu''à lui-même.
verses.am: በውኑ ሰው እግዚአብሔርን ይጠቅመዋልን?  በእውነት ጥበበኛ ሰው ራሱን ይጠቅማል።

verses.en: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?
verses.fr: Si tu es juste, est-ce à l''avantage du Tout-Puissant? Si tu es intègre dans tes voies, qu''y gagne-t-il?
verses.am: ጻድቅ መሆንህስ ሁሉን የሚችለውን አምላክ ደስ ያሰኘዋልን?  መንገድህን ማቅናትህስ ይጠቅመዋልን?

verses.en: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
verses.fr: Est-ce par crainte de toi qu''il te châtie, Qu''il entre en jugement avec toi?
verses.am: እርሱንስ ስለ ፈራህ ይዘልፍሃልን?  ወደ ፍርድስ ከአንተ ጋር ይገባልን?

verses.en: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
verses.fr: Ta méchanceté n''est-elle pas grande? Tes iniquités ne sont-elles pas infinies?
verses.am: ክፋትህስ የበዛ አይደለምን?  ለኃጢአትህም ፍጻሜ የላትም።

verses.en: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
verses.fr: Tu enlevais sans motif des gages à tes frères, Tu privais de leurs vêtements ceux qui étaient nus;
verses.am: የወንድሞችህን መያዣ በከንቱ ወስደሃል፥  የእርዘኞቹንም ልብስ ዘርፈሃል።

verses.en: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
verses.fr: Tu ne donnais point d''eau à l''homme altéré, Tu refusais du pain à l''homme affamé.
verses.am: ለደካማ ውኃ አላጠጣህም፥  ለራብተኛም እንጀራን ከልክለሃል።

verses.en: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.
verses.fr: Le pays était au plus fort, Et le puissant s''y établissait.
verses.am: በክንድ የበረታ ምድርን ገዛ፤  ከበርቴውም ሰው ተቀመጠባት።

verses.en: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
verses.fr: Tu renvoyais les veuves à vide; Les bras des orphelins étaient brisés.
verses.am: መበለቲቱን አንዳች አልባ ሰድደሃታል፤  የድሀ አደጎችም ክንድ ተሰብሮአል።

verses.en: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;
verses.fr: C''est pour cela que tu es entouré de pièges, Et que la terreur t''a saisi tout à coup.
verses.am: ስለዚህ አሽክላ ከብቦሃል፥  ድንገተኛ ፍርሃትም አናውጦሃል።

verses.en: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.
verses.fr: Ne vois-tu donc pas ces ténèbres, Ces eaux débordées qui t''envahissent?
verses.am: እንዳታይ ብርሃን ጨለማ ሆነችብህ፥  የውኆችም ብዛት አሰጠመህ።

verses.en: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!
verses.fr: Dieu n''est-il pas en haut dans les cieux? Regarde le sommet des étoiles, comme il est élevé!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሰማያት ከፍ ከፍ አይልምን?  ከዋክብትም እንዴት ከፍ ከፍ እንዳሉ ተመልከት።

verses.en: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?
verses.fr: Et tu dis: Qu''est-ce que Dieu sait? Peut-il juger à travers l''obscurité?
verses.am: አንተም። እግዚአብሔር ምን ያውቃል?  በድቅድቅ ጨለማ ውስጥ ሆኖ ሊፈርድ ይችላልን?

verses.en: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
verses.fr: Les nuées l''enveloppent, et il ne voit rien; Il ne parcourt que la voûte des cieux.
verses.am: እንዳያይ የጠቈረ ደመና ጋርዶታል፤  በሰማይ ክበብ ላይ ይራመዳል ብለሃል።

verses.en: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
verses.fr: Eh quoi! tu voudrais prendre l''ancienne route Qu''ont suivie les hommes d''iniquité?
verses.am: በውኑ ኃጢአተኞች ሰዎች የረገጡአትን  የዱሮይቱን መንገድ ትጠብቃለህን?

verses.en: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
verses.fr: Ils ont été emportés avant le temps, Ils ont eu la durée d''un torrent qui s''écoule.
verses.am: ጊዜያቸው ሳይደርስ ተነጠቁ፤  መሠረታቸውም እንደ ፈሳሽ ውኃ ፈሰሰ።

verses.en: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?
verses.fr: Ils disaient à Dieu: Retire-toi de nous; Que peut faire pour nous le Tout-Puissant?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም። ከእኛ ዘንድ ራቅ፤  ሁሉንም የሚችል አምላክ ምን ሊያደርግልን ይችላል? አሉት።

verses.en: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.fr: Dieu cependant avait rempli de biens leurs maisons. -Loin de moi le conseil des méchants!
verses.am: ነገር ግን ቤታቸውን በመልካም ነገር ሞላ፤  የኃጥአን ምክር ከእኔ ዘንድ የራቀች ናት።

verses.en: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.
verses.fr: Les justes, témoins de leur chute, se réjouiront, Et l''innocent se moquera d''eux:
verses.am: ጻድቃን ያዩታል፥ ደስም ይላቸዋል፤  ንጹሐንም በንቀት ይስቁባቸዋል።

verses.en: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.
verses.fr: Voilà nos adversaires anéantis! Voilà leurs richesses dévorées par le feu!
verses.am: በእውነት ሀብታቸው ጠፋ፥  የቀረውንም እሳት በላች።

verses.en: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.
verses.fr: Attache-toi donc à Dieu, et tu auras la paix; Tu jouiras ainsi du bonheur.
verses.am: አሁንም ከእርሱ ጋር ተስማማ፥ ሰላምም ይኑርህ፤  በዚያም በጎነት ታገኛለህ።

verses.en: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.
verses.fr: Reçois de sa bouche l''instruction, Et mets dans ton coeur ses paroles.
verses.am: ከአፉም ሕጉን ተቀበል፥  በልብህም ቃሉን አኑር፤

verses.en: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
verses.fr: Tu seras rétabli, si tu reviens au Tout-Puissant, Si tu éloignes l''iniquité de ta tente.
verses.am: ሁሉን ወደሚችል አምላክ ብትመለስ፥ ብትዋረድም፥  ኃጢአትንም ከድንኳንህ ብታርቅ፥

verses.en: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.
verses.fr: Jette l''or dans la poussière, L''or d''Ophir parmi les cailloux des torrents;
verses.am: የወርቅን ዕቃ በአፈር ውስጥ፥  የኦፊርንም ወርቅ በጅረት ድንጋይ መካከል ብትጥል፥

verses.en: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.
verses.fr: Et le Tout-Puissant sera ton or, Ton argent, ta richesse.
verses.am: ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ ወርቅና የሚብለጨለጭ ብር ይሆንልሃል።

verses.en: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.
verses.fr: Alors tu feras du Tout-Puissant tes délices, Tu élèveras vers Dieu ta face;
verses.am: የዚያን ጊዜ ሁሉን በሚችል አምላክ ደስ ይልሃል፥  ፊትህንም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ታነሣለህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.
verses.fr: Tu le prieras, et il t''exaucera, Et tu accompliras tes voeux.
verses.am: ወደ እርሱም ትጸልያለህ፥ እርሱም ይሰማሃል፤  ስእለትህንም ትሰጣለህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
verses.fr: A tes résolutions répondra le succès; Sur tes sentiers brillera la lumière.
verses.am: ነገርንም ትመክራለህ፥ እርሱም ይሳካልሃል፤  ብርሃንም በመንገድህ ላይ ይበራል።

verses.en: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
verses.fr: Vienne l''humiliation, tu prieras pour ton relèvement: Dieu secourt celui dont le regard est abattu.
verses.am: ቢያዋርዱህ አንተ ከፍ ከፍ ትላለህ፤  ትሑቱንም ሰው ያድነዋል።

verses.en: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.
verses.fr: Il délivrera même le coupable, Qui devra son salut à la pureté de tes mains.
verses.am: ንጹሑን ሰው ያድነዋል፤  በእጅህም ንጽሕና ትድናለህ።

verses.en: Then Job answered and said,
verses.fr: Job prit la parole et dit:
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.
verses.fr: Maintenant encore ma plainte est une révolte, Mais la souffrance étouffe mes soupirs.
verses.am: ዛሬም ደግሞ የኅዘን እንጕርጕሮዬ ገና መራራ ነው፤  እጁ በልቅሶ ጩኸቴ ላይ ከብዳለች።

verses.en: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!
verses.fr: Oh! si je savais où le trouver, Si je pouvais arriver jusqu''à son trône,
verses.am: እርሱን ወዴት እንዳገኘው ምነው ባወቅሁ!  ወደ ተቀመጠበትስ ስፍራ ምነው በደረስሁ!

verses.en: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.fr: Je plaiderais ma cause devant lui, Je remplirais ma bouche d''arguments,
verses.am: በፊቱ ሙግቴን አዘጋጅ ነበር፥  አፌንም በማስረጃ እሞላው ነበር።

verses.en: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
verses.fr: Je connaîtrais ce qu''il peut avoir à répondre, Je verrais ce qu''il peut avoir à me dire.
verses.am: የሚመልስልኝም ቃል ምን እንደ ሆነ አውቅ ነበር፥  የሚለኝንም አስተውል ነበር።

verses.en: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.
verses.fr: Emploierait-il toute sa force à me combattre? Ne daignerait-il pas au moins m''écouter?
verses.am: በኃይሉ ብዛት ከእኔ ጋር ይምዋገት ነበርን?  እንኳን! ያደምጠኝ ነበር።

verses.en: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
verses.fr: Ce serait un homme droit qui plaiderait avec lui, Et je serais pour toujours absous par mon juge.
verses.am: ቅን ሰው ከእርሱ ጋር በዚያ ይከራከር ነበር፤  እኔም ከፈራጄ ለዘላለም እድን ነበር።

verses.en: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:
verses.fr: Mais, si je vais à l''orient, il n''y est pas; Si je vais à l''occident, je ne le trouve pas;
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ወደ ፊት እሄዳለሁ፥ እርሱም የለም፤  ወደ ኋላም እሄዳለሁ፥ እኔም አላስተውለውም፤

verses.en: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:
verses.fr: Est-il occupé au nord, je ne puis le voir; Se cache-t-il au midi, je ne puis le découvrir.
verses.am: ወደሚሠራበት ወደ ግራ ብሄድ አልመለከተውም፤  በቀኜም ይሰወራል፥ አላየውምም፤

verses.en: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
verses.fr: Il sait néanmoins quelle voie j''ai suivie; Et, s''il m''éprouvait, je sortirais pur comme l''or.
verses.am: የምሄድበትን መንገድ ያውቃል፤  ከፈተነኝም በኋላ እንደ ወርቅ እወጣለሁ።

verses.en: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
verses.fr: Mon pied s''est attaché à ses pas; J''ai gardé sa voie, et je ne m''en suis point détourné.
verses.am: እግሬ ወደ እርምጃው ተጣብቆአል፤  መንገዱንም ጠብቄአለሁ፥ ፈቀቅም አላልሁም።

verses.en: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
verses.fr: Je n''ai pas abandonné les commandements de ses lèvres; J''ai fait plier ma volonté aux paroles de sa bouche.
verses.am: ከከንፈሩ ትእዛዝ አልተመለስሁም፤  የአፉን ቃል በልቤ ሰውሬአለሁ።

verses.en: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.
verses.fr: Mais sa résolution est arrêtée; qui s''y opposera? Ce que son âme désire, il l''exécute.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ብቻውን ነው፤ እርሱንስ የሚመስለው ማን ነው?  ነፍሱም የወደደችውን ያደርጋል።

verses.en: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.
verses.fr: Il accomplira donc ses desseins à mon égard, Et il en concevra bien d''autres encore.
verses.am: በእኔ ላይ የተወሰነውን ይፈጽማል፤  እንደዚህም ያለ ብዙ ነገር በእርሱ ዘንድ አለ።

verses.en: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
verses.fr: Voilà pourquoi sa présence m''épouvante; Quand j''y pense, j''ai peur de lui.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በፊቱ ደነገጥሁ፤  ባሰብሁም ጊዜ ከእርሱ ፈራሁ።

verses.en: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:
verses.fr: Dieu a brisé mon courage, Le Tout-Puissant m''a rempli d''effroi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ልቤን አባብቶታልና፥  ሁሉንም የሚችል አምላክ አስደንግጦኛል።

verses.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.
verses.fr: Car ce ne sont pas les ténèbres qui m''anéantissent, Ce n''est pas l''obscurité dont je suis couvert.
verses.am: ከጨለማው የተነሣ፥  ድቅድቁም ጨለማ ፊቴን ከመክደኑ የተነሣ አልደነገጥሁም።

verses.en: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
verses.fr: Pourquoi le Tout-Puissant ne met-il pas des temps en réserve, Et pourquoi ceux qui le connaissent ne voient-ils pas ses jours?
verses.am: ሁሉን ከሚችል አምላክ ዘንድ ዘመናት አልተሰወረምና  እርሱን የሚያውቁ ለምን ወራቱን አያዩም?

verses.en: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.
verses.fr: On déplace les bornes, On vole des troupeaux, et on les fait paître;
verses.am: የድንበሩን ምልክት የሚያፈርሱ አሉ፤  መንጋዎቹን በዝብዘው ያሰማራሉ።

verses.en: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.
verses.fr: On enlève l''âne de l''orphelin, On prend pour gage le boeuf de la veuve;
verses.am: የድሀ አድጎቹን አህያ ይነዳሉ፤  የመበለቲቱን በሬ ስለ መያዣ ይወስዳሉ።

verses.en: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.
verses.fr: On repousse du chemin les indigents, On force tous les malheureux du pays à se cacher.
verses.am: ድሆቹን ከመንገዱ ያወጣሉ፤  የምድርም ችግረኞች ሁሉ ይሸሸጋሉ።

verses.en: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.
verses.fr: Et voici, comme les ânes sauvages du désert, Ils sortent le matin pour chercher de la nourriture, Ils n''ont que le désert pour trouver le pain de leurs enfants;
verses.am: እነሆ፥ በምድረ በዳ እንዳሉ እንደ ሜዳ አህዮች፥  መብልን ፈልገው ወደ ሥራቸው ይወጣሉ፤  ምድረ በዳውም ለልጆቻቸው መብልን ይሰጣቸዋል።

verses.en: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
verses.fr: Ils coupent le fourrage qui reste dans les champs, Ils grappillent dans la vigne de l''impie;
verses.am: እነዚያ በእርሻ ውስጥ እህላቸውን ያጭዳሉ፤  የበደለኛውንም ወይን ይቃርማሉ።

verses.en: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.
verses.fr: Ils passent la nuit dans la nudité, sans vêtement, Sans couverture contre le froid;
verses.am: ራቁታቸውን ያለ ልብስ ያድራሉ፥  በብርድ ጊዜ መጐናጸፊያ የላቸውም።

verses.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
verses.fr: Ils sont percés par la pluie des montagnes, Et ils embrassent les rochers comme unique refuge.
verses.am: ከተራሮች በሚወርድ ዝናብ ይረጥባሉ፤  መጠጊያም አጥተው ቋጥኙን ያቅፋሉ።

verses.en: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.
verses.fr: On arrache l''orphelin à la mamelle, On prend des gages sur le pauvre.
verses.am: ድሀ አደጉን ልጅ ከጡቱ የሚነጥሉ አሉ  ከችግረኛውም መያዣ ይወስዳሉ።

verses.en: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;
verses.fr: Ils vont tout nus, sans vêtement, Ils sont affamés, et ils portent les gerbes;
verses.am: ያለ ልብስ ራቁታቸውን ይሄዳሉ፤  ተርበውም ነዶዎችን ይሸከማሉ፤

verses.en: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.
verses.fr: Dans les enclos de l''impie ils font de l''huile, Ils foulent le pressoir, et ils ont soif;
verses.am: በእነዚህ ሰዎች አጥር ውስጥ ዘይት ያደርጋሉ፤  ወይንም ይጠምቃሉ፥ ነገር ግን ይጠማሉ።

verses.en: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.
verses.fr: Dans les villes s''exhalent les soupirs des mourants, L''âme des blessés jette des cris.... Et Dieu ne prend pas garde à ces infamies!
verses.am: ከከተማውና ከገዛ ቤቶቻቸው ይባረራሉ፤  የልጆችም ነፍስ ለእርዳታ ትጮኻለች፤  እግዚአብሔር ግን ስንፍናቸውን አይመለከትም።

verses.en: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
verses.fr: D''autres sont ennemis de la lumière, Ils n''en connaissent pas les voies, Ils n''en pratiquent pas les sentiers.
verses.am: እነዚህ በብርሃን ላይ የሚያምፁ ናቸው፤  መንገዱን አያውቁም፥ በጎዳናውም አይጸኑም።

verses.en: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.
verses.fr: L''assassin se lève au point du jour, Tue le pauvre et l''indigent, Et il dérobe pendant la nuit.
verses.am: ነፍሰ ገዳዩም ሳይነጋ ማልዶ ይነሣል፤  ችግረኞችንና ድሆችን ይገድላል፤  በሌሊትም እንደ ሌባ ነው።

verses.en: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.
verses.fr: L''oeil de l''adultère épie le crépuscule; Personne ne me verra, dit-il, Et il met un voile sur sa figure.
verses.am: የአመንዝራም ዓይን ድግዝግዝታን ይጠብቃል።  የማንም ዓይን አያየኝም ይላል፥  ፊቱንም ይሸፍናል።

verses.en: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.
verses.fr: La nuit ils forcent les maisons, Le jour ils se tiennent enfermés; Ils ne connaissent pas la lumière.
verses.am: ቤቶቹን በጨለማ ይነድላሉ፤  በቀን ይሸሸጋሉ፤  ብርሃንም አያውቁም።

verses.en: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.
verses.fr: Pour eux, le matin c''est l''ombre de la mort, Ils en éprouvent toutes les terreurs.
verses.am: የጥዋት ብርሃን ለእነርሱ ሁሉ እንደ ሞት ጥላ ነው፤  የሞትን ጥላ ድንጋጤ ያውቃሉና።

verses.en: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.
verses.fr: Eh quoi! l''impie est d''un poids léger sur la face des eaux, Il n''a sur la terre qu''une part maudite, Il ne prend jamais le chemin des vignes!
verses.am: እነርሱ በውኃ ፊት ላይ በርረው ያልፋሉ፤  እድል ፈንታቸውም በምድር ላይ የተረገመች ናት፤  ወደ ወይኑ ቦታ መንገድ አይዞሩም።

verses.en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.
verses.fr: Comme la sécheresse et la chaleur absorbent les eaux de la neige, Ainsi le séjour des morts engloutit ceux qui pèchent!
verses.am: ድርቅና ሙቀት የአመዳዩን ውኃ ያጠፋሉ፤  እንዲሁ ሲኦል በደለኞችን ታጠፋለች።

verses.en: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
verses.fr: Quoi! le sein maternel l''oublie, Les vers en font leurs délices, On ne se souvient plus de lui! L''impie est brisé comme un arbre,
verses.am: ማኅፀን ትረሳዋለች፤  ትልም በደስታ ይጠባዋል፤  ዳግመኛም አይታሰብም፤  ክፋትም እንደ ዛፍ ይሰበራል።

verses.en: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.
verses.fr: Lui qui dépouille la femme stérile et sans enfants, Lui qui ne répand aucun bienfait sur la veuve!...
verses.am: የማትወልደውን መካኒቱን ይበድላታል፤  ለመበለቲቱም በጎነት አያደርግም።

verses.en: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.
verses.fr: Non! Dieu par sa force prolonge les jours des violents, Et les voilà debout quand ils désespéraient de la vie;
verses.am: ነገር ግን በኃይሉ ኃያላንን ይስባል፤  እርሱም በተነሣ ጊዜ ሰው በሕይወቱ አይታመንም።

verses.en: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.
verses.fr: Il leur donne de la sécurité et de la confiance, Il a les regards sur leurs voies.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በደኅና አኑሮአቸዋል፥  በዚያም ይታመናሉ፤  ዓይኖቹ ግን በመንገዳቸው ላይ ናቸው።

verses.en: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.
verses.fr: Ils se sont élevés; et en un instant ils ne sont plus, Ils tombent, ils meurent comme tous les hommes, Ils sont coupés comme la tête des épis.
verses.am: ጥቂት ጊዜ ከፍ ከፍ ይላሉ፤  ይሄዳሉ፥ ይጠወልጋሉም፤  እንደ ሌሎች ሁሉ ይከማቻሉ፤  እንደ እሸትም ራስ ይቈረጣሉ።

verses.en: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
verses.fr: S''il n''en est pas ainsi, qui me démentira, Qui réduira mes paroles à néant?
verses.am: እንዲህስ ባይሆን ሐሰተኛ የሚያደርገኝ፥  ነገሬንስ እንደ ምናምን የሚያደርገው ማን ነው?

verses.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.fr: Bildad de Schuach prit la parole et dit:
verses.am: ሹሐዊውም በልዳዶስ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.
verses.fr: La puissance et la terreur appartiennent à Dieu; Il fait régner la paix dans ses hautes régions.
verses.am: ገዢነትና መፈራት በእርሱ ዘንድ ናቸው፤  በከፍታውም ሰላም አድራጊ ነው።

verses.en: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?
verses.fr: Ses armées ne sont-elles pas innombrables? Sur qui sa lumière ne se lève-t-elle pas?
verses.am: በውኑ ለሠራዊቶቹ ቍጥር አላቸውን?  ብርሃኑስ የማይወጣው በማን ላይ ነው?

verses.en: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?
verses.fr: Comment l''homme serait-il juste devant Dieu? Comment celui qui est né de la femme serait-il pur?
verses.am: ሰውስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጻድቅ ይሆን ዘንድ፥  ከሴትስ የተወለደ ንጹሕ ይሆን ዘንድ እንዴት ይችላል?

verses.en: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
verses.fr: Voici, la lune même n''est pas brillante, Et les étoiles ne sont pas pures à ses yeux;
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ጨረቃ እንኳ ብሩህ አይደለም፥  ከዋክብትም በፊቱ ንጹሐን አይደሉም።

verses.en: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?
verses.fr: Combien moins l''homme, qui n''est qu''un ver, Le fils de l''homme, qui n''est qu''un vermisseau!
verses.am: ይልቁንስ ብስብስ የሆነ ሰው፥  ትልም የሆነ የሰው ልጅ ምንኛ ያንስ!

verses.en: But Job answered and said,
verses.fr: Job prit la parole et dit:
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?
verses.fr: Comme tu sais bien venir en aide à la faiblesse! Comme tu prêtes secours au bras sans force!
verses.am: ኃይል የሌለውን ምንኛ ረዳኸው!  ብርታት የሌለውን ክንድ ምንኛ አዳንኸው!

verses.en: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
verses.fr: Quels bons conseils tu donnes à celui qui manque d''intelligence! Quelle abondance de sagesse tu fais paraître!
verses.am: ጥበብስ የሌለውን ምንኛ መከርኸው!  ብዙ እውቀትንስ ምንኛ ገለጥህለት!

verses.en: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?
verses.fr: A qui s''adressent tes paroles? Et qui est-ce qui t''inspire?
verses.am: ይህንስ ቃል በማን እርዳታ ተናገርህ?  የማንስ መንፈስ ከአንተ ዘንድ ወጣ?

verses.en: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.fr: Devant Dieu les ombres tremblent Au-dessous des eaux et de leurs habitants;
verses.am: ሙታን ሰዎች ከውኆች በታች፥  በውኆችም ውስጥ ከሚኖሩ በታች ይንቀጠቀጣሉ።

verses.en: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
verses.fr: Devant lui le séjour des morts est nu, L''abîme n''a point de voile.
verses.am: ሲኦል በፊቱ ራቁትዋን ናት፥  ለጥፋትም መጋረጃ የለውም።

verses.en: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
verses.fr: Il étend le septentrion sur le vide, Il suspend la terre sur le néant.
verses.am: ሰሜንን በባዶ ስፍራ ላይ ይዘረጋል፥  ምድሪቱንም በታችዋ አንዳች አልባ ያንጠለጥላል።

verses.en: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.
