verses.am: እኛ ከጨለማ የተነሣ በሥርዓት መናገር አንችልምና  የምንለውን አስታውቀን።

verses.en: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.
verses.fr: Lui annoncera-t-on que je parlerai? Mais quel est l''homme qui désire sa perte?
verses.am: ማንም በእርሱ ላይ ቢናገር ፈጽሞ ይዋጣልና  እኔ እናገር ዘንድ ብወድድ ሰው ይነግረዋልን?

verses.en: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.
verses.fr: On ne peut fixer le soleil qui resplendit dans les cieux, Lorsqu''un vent passe et en ramène la pureté;
verses.am: አሁንም ነፋስ አልፎ ካጠራቸው በኋላ፥  ሰው በሰማያት የሚበራውን ብርሃን ሊመለከት አይችልም።

verses.en: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.
verses.fr: Le septentrion le rend éclatant comme l''or. Oh! que la majesté de Dieu est redoutable!
verses.am: ከሰሜን ወርቅ የሚመስል ጌጠኛ ብርሃን ይወጣል፤  በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የሚያስፈራ ግርማ አለ።

verses.en: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.
verses.fr: Nous ne saurions parvenir jusqu''au Tout-Puissant, Grand par la force, Par la justice, par le droit souverain: Il ne répond pas!
verses.am: ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክን እናገኝ ዘንድ አንችልም፤  በኃይል ታላቅ ነው፤  በፍርድና በጽድቅም አያስጨንቅም።

verses.en: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi les hommes doivent le craindre; Il ne porte les regards sur aucun sage.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሰዎች ይፈሩታል፤  በልባቸውም ጠቢባን የሆኑትን ሁሉ አይመለከትም።

verses.en: Then the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.fr: L''Eternel répondit à Job du milieu de la tempête et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በዐውሎ ነፋስ ውስጥ ሆኖ ለኢዮብ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
verses.fr: Qui est celui qui obscurcit mes desseins Par des discours sans intelligence?
verses.am: ያለ እውቀት በሚነገር ቃል  ምክርን የሚያጨልም ይህ ማነው?

verses.en: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.
verses.fr: Ceins tes reins comme un vaillant homme; Je t''interrogerai, et tu m''instruiras.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንደ ሰው ወገብህን ታጠቅ፤  እጠይቅሃለሁ፥ አንተም ተናገረኝ።

verses.en: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
verses.fr: Où étais-tu quand je fondais la terre? Dis-le, si tu as de l''intelligence.
verses.am: ምድርን በመሠረትሁ ጊዜ አንተ ወዴት ነበርህ?  ታስተውል እንደ ሆንህ ተናገር።

verses.en: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?
verses.fr: Qui en a fixé les dimensions, le sais-tu? Ou qui a étendu sur elle le cordeau?
verses.am: ብታውቅስ መሠፈሪያዋን የወሰነ፥  በላይዋስ የመለኪያ ገመድ የዘረጋ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;
verses.fr: Sur quoi ses bases sont-elles appuyées? Ou qui en a posé la pierre angulaire,
verses.am: አጥቢያ ኮከቦች በአንድነት ሲዘምሩ፥  የእግዚአብሔርም ልጆች ሁሉ እልል ሲሉ፥  መሠረቶችዋ በምን ላይ ተተክለው ነበር?  የማዕዘንዋንስ ድንጋይ ያቆመ ማን ነው?

verses.en: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.fr: Alors que les étoiles du matin éclataient en chants d''allégresse, Et que tous les fils de Dieu poussaient des cris de joie?
verses.am: አጥቢያ ኮከቦች በአንድነት ሲዘምሩ፥  የእግዚአብሔርም ልጆች ሁሉ እልል ሲሉ፥  መሠረቶችዋ በምን ላይ ተተክለው ነበር?  የማዕዘንዋንስ ድንጋይ ያቆመ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?
verses.fr: Qui a fermé la mer avec des portes, Quand elle s''élança du sein maternel;
verses.am: ከማኅፀን እንደሚወጣ በወጣ ጊዜ  ባሕርን በመዝጊያዎች የዘጋ ማን ነው?

verses.en: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
verses.fr: Quand je fis de la nuée son vêtement, Et de l''obscurité ses langes;
verses.am: ደመናውን ለልብሱ፥  ጨለማንም ለመጠቅለያው አደረግሁ፤

verses.en: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,
verses.fr: Quand je lui imposai ma loi, Et que je lui mis des barrières et des portes;
verses.am: ድንበሩን በዙሪያው አድርጌ፥  መወርወሪያዎቹንና መዝጊያዎቹን አኑሬ።

verses.en: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
verses.fr: Quand je dis: Tu viendras jusqu''ici, tu n''iras pas au delà; Ici s''arrêtera l''orgueil de tes flots?
verses.am: እስከዚህ ድረስ ድረሺ፥ አትለፊ፤  በዚህም ለትዕቢተኛው ማዕበልሽ ገደብ ይሁን አልሁ።

verses.en: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;
verses.fr: Depuis que tu existes, as-tu commandé au matin? As-tu montré sa place à l''aurore,
verses.am: ጭቃ ከማኅተም በታች እንደሚለወጥ እንዲሁ እርስዋ ትለወጣለች፤  ነገርም ሁሉ እንደ ልብስ ተቀልሞአል።

verses.en: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?
verses.fr: Pour qu''elle saisisse les extrémités de la terre, Et que les méchants en soient secoués;
verses.am: ጭቃ ከማኅተም በታች እንደሚለወጥ እንዲሁ እርስዋ ትለወጣለች፤  ነገርም ሁሉ እንደ ልብስ ተቀልሞአል።

verses.en: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.
verses.fr: Pour que la terre se transforme comme l''argile qui reçoit une empreinte, Et qu''elle soit parée comme d''un vêtement;
verses.am: ከበደለኞች ብርሃናቸው ተከልክሎአል፥  ከፍ ያለውም ክንድ ተሰብሮአል።

verses.en: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.
verses.fr: Pour que les méchants soient privés de leur lumière, Et que le bras qui se lève soit brisé?
verses.am: ወደ ባሕር ምንጭስ ውስጥ ገብተሃልን?  በቀላዩስ መሠረት ውስጥ ተመላልሰሃልን?

verses.en: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?
verses.fr: As-tu pénétré jusqu''aux sources de la mer? T''es-tu promené dans les profondeurs de l''abîme?
verses.am: የሞት በሮች ተገልጠውልሃልን?  የሞትንስ ጥላ ደጆች አይተሃልን?

verses.en: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?
verses.fr: Les portes de la mort t''ont-elles été ouvertes? As-tu vu les portes de l''ombre de la mort?
verses.am: ምድርንስ በስፋትዋ አስተውለሃታልን?  ሁሉን አውቀህ እንደ ሆነ ተናገር።

verses.en: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.
verses.fr: As-tu embrassé du regard l''étendue de la terre? Parle, si tu sais toutes ces choses.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ተወልደህ ነበርና፥  የዕድሜህም ቍጥር ብዙ ነውና፤  በእውነት አንተ ሳታውቅ አትቀርም።

verses.en: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,
verses.fr: Où est le chemin qui conduit au séjour de la lumière? Et les ténèbres, où ont-elles leur demeure?
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ተወልደህ ነበርና፥  የዕድሜህም ቍጥር ብዙ ነውና፤  በእውነት አንተ ሳታውቅ አትቀርም።

verses.en: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?
verses.fr: Peux-tu les saisir à leur limite, Et connaître les sentiers de leur habitation?
verses.am: በውኑ ወደ በረዶው ቤተ መዛግብት ገብተሃልን?  የበረዶውንስ ቅንጣት ቤተ መዛግብት አይተሃልን?

verses.en: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?
verses.fr: Tu le sais, car alors tu étais né, Et le nombre de tes jours est grand!
verses.am: ይኸውም ለመከራ ጊዜ ለሰልፍና ለጦርነት ቀን የጠበቅሁት ነው።

verses.en: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
verses.fr: Es-tu parvenu jusqu''aux amas de neige? As-tu vu les dépôts de grêle,
verses.am: ብርሃንስ በምን መንገድ ይከፈላል?  የምሥራቅስ ነፋስ በምድር ላይ እንዴት ይበተናል?

verses.en: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
verses.fr: Que je tiens en réserve pour les temps de détresse, Pour les jours de guerre et de bataille?
verses.am: ሣሩንም እንዲያበቅል፥  ማንም በሌለባት ምድር ላይ፥  ሰውም በሌለባት ምድረ በዳ ላይ ዝናብን ያዘንብ ዘንድ፥  ለፈሳሹ ውኃ መንዶልዶያውን፥  ወይስ ለሚያንጐደጕድ መብረቅ መንገድን ያበጀ ማን ነው?

verses.en: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
verses.fr: Par quel chemin la lumière se divise-t-elle, Et le vent d''orient se répand-il sur la terre?
verses.am: ሣሩንም እንዲያበቅል፥  ማንም በሌለባት ምድር ላይ፥  ሰውም በሌለባት ምድረ በዳ ላይ ዝናብን ያዘንብ ዘንድ፥  ለፈሳሹ ውኃ መንዶልዶያውን፥  ወይስ ለሚያንጐደጕድ መብረቅ መንገድን ያበጀ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
verses.fr: Qui a ouvert un passage à la pluie, Et tracé la route de l''éclair et du tonnerre,
verses.am: በውኑ ለዝናብ አባት አለውን?  ወይስ የጠልን ነጠብጣብ የወለደ ማን ነው?

verses.en: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
verses.fr: Pour que la pluie tombe sur une terre sans habitants, Sur un désert où il n''y a point d''hommes;
verses.am: በረዶስ ከማን ማኅፀን ወጣ?  የሰማዩንስ አመዳይ ማን ወለደው?

verses.en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
verses.fr: Pour qu''elle abreuve les lieux solitaires et arides, Et qu''elle fasse germer et sortir l''herbe?
verses.am: ውኆች እንደ ድንጋይ ጠነከሩ፥  የቀላዩም ፊት ረግቶአል።

verses.en: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
verses.fr: La pluie a-t-elle un père? Qui fait naître les gouttes de la rosée?
verses.am: በውኑ የሰባቱን ከዋክብት ዘለላ ታስር ዘንድ፥  ወይስ ኦሪዮን የሚባለውን ኮከብ ትፈታ ዘንድ ትችላለህን?

verses.en: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
verses.fr: Du sein de qui sort la glace, Et qui enfante le frimas du ciel,
verses.am: ወይስ ማዛሮት የሚባሉትን ከዋክብት በጊዜያቸው ታወጣ ዘንድ፥  ወይስ ድብ የሚባለውን ኮከብ ከልጆቹ ጋር ትመራ ዘንድ ትችላለህን?

verses.en: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
verses.fr: Pour que les eaux se cachent comme une pierre, Et que la surface de l''abîme soit enchaînée?
verses.am: የሰማይን ሥርዓት ታውቃለህን?  በምድርስ ለይ እንዲሠለጥን ልታደርግ ትችላለህን?

verses.en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
verses.fr: Noues-tu les liens des Pléiades, Ou détaches-tu les cordages de l''Orion?
verses.am: የውኆች ብዛት ይሸፍንህ ዘንድ  ቃልህን ወደ ደመናት ታነሣ ዘንድ ትችላለህን?

verses.en: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
verses.fr: Fais-tu paraître en leur temps les signes du zodiaque, Et conduis-tu la Grande Ourse avec ses petits?
verses.am: መብረቆች ሄደው። እነሆ፥ እዚህ አለን ይሉህ ዘንድ  ልትልካቸው ትችላለህን?

verses.en: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
verses.fr: Connais-tu les lois du ciel? Règles-tu son pouvoir sur la terre?
verses.am: በውስጡስ ጥበብን ያኖረ፥  ለሰውስ ልብ ማስተዋልን የሰጠ ማን ነው?

verses.en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?
verses.fr: Elèves-tu la voix jusqu''aux nuées, Pour appeler à toi des torrents d''eaux?
verses.am: ልጆቹ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሲጮኹ፥  የሚበሉትም አጥተው ሲቅበዘበዙ፥  ለቍራ መብልን የሚሰጠው ማን ነው?

verses.en: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go and say unto thee, Here we are?
verses.fr: Lances-tu les éclairs? Partent-ils? Te disent-ils: Nous voici?
verses.am: ልጆቹ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሲጮኹ፥  የሚበሉትም አጥተው ሲቅበዘበዙ፥  ለቍራ መብልን የሚሰጠው ማን ነው?

verses.en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?
verses.fr: Qui a mis la sagesse dans le coeur, Ou qui a donné l''intelligence à l''esprit?
verses.am: ልጆቹ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሲጮኹ፥  የሚበሉትም አጥተው ሲቅበዘበዙ፥  ለቍራ መብልን የሚሰጠው ማን ነው?

verses.en: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,
verses.fr: Qui peut avec sagesse compter les nuages, Et verser les outres des cieux,

verses.en: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?
verses.fr: Pour que la poussière se mette à ruisseler, Et que les mottes de terre se collent ensemble?
verses.am: ፤ የሰማይን ደመና በጥበቡ ሊቈጥር የሚችል ማን ነው? ትቢያ በተበጠበጠ ጊዜ፥ ጓሎቹም በተጣበቁ ጊዜ፥ የሰማይን ረዋት ሊያዘነብል የሚችል ማን ነው?

verses.en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,
verses.fr: Chasses-tu la proie pour la lionne, Et apaises-tu la faim des lionceaux,

verses.en: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?
verses.fr: Quand ils sont couchés dans leur tanière, Quand ils sont en embuscade dans leur repaire?
verses.am: ፤ በዋሾቻቸው ውስጥ ተጋድመው፥ በጫካም ውስጥ አድብተው ሳሉ፥ ለአንበሳይቱ አደን ታድናለህን? የልጆችዋንስ ነፍስ ታጠግብ ዘንድ ትችላለህን?

verses.en: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
verses.fr: Qui prépare au corbeau sa pâture, Quand ses petits crient vers Dieu, Quand ils sont errants et affamés?
verses.am: ፤ ልጆቹ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሲጮኹ፥ የሚበሉትም አጥተው ሲቅበዘበዙ፥ ለቍራ መብልን የሚሰጠው ማን ነው?

verses.en: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
verses.fr: Sais-tu quand les chèvres sauvages font leurs petits? Observes-tu les biches quand elles mettent bas?
verses.am: የበረሃ ፍየል የምትወልድበትን ጊዜ ታውቃለህን?  ዋላይቱስ የምታምጥበትን ጊዜ ትመለከታለህን?

verses.en: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
verses.fr: Comptes-tu les mois pendant lesquels elles portent, Et connais-tu l''époque où elles enfantent?
verses.am: እርስዋ የምትፈጽመውንስ ወራት ትቈጥራለህን?  የምትወልድበትንስ ጊዜ ታውቃለህን?

verses.en: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
verses.fr: Elles se courbent, laissent échapper leur progéniture, Et sont délivrées de leurs douleurs.
verses.am: ይንበረከካሉ፥ ልጆቻቸውንም ይወልዳሉ፥  ከምጣቸውም ያርፋሉ።

verses.en: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.
verses.fr: Leurs petits prennent de la vigueur et grandissent en plein air, Ils s''éloignent et ne reviennent plus auprès d''elles.
verses.am: ልጆቻቸው ይጠነክራሉ፥  በሜዳም ያድጋሉ፤  ይወጣሉ፥ ወደ እነርሱም አይመለሱም።

verses.en: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
verses.fr: Qui met en liberté l''âne sauvage, Et l''affranchit de tout lien?
verses.am: የሜዳውስ አህያ አርነት ማን አወጣው?  የበረሃውንስ አህያ ከእስራቱ ማን ፈታው?

verses.en: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
verses.fr: J''ai fait du désert son habitation, De la terre salée sa demeure.
verses.am: በረሃውን ለእርሱ ቤት አድርጌ ሰጠሁት፤  መኖሪያውም በጨው ምድር ነው።

verses.en: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.
verses.fr: Il se rit du tumulte des villes, Il n''entend pas les cris d''un maître.
verses.am: በከተማ ውካታ ይዘብታል፤  የነጂውን ጩኸት አይሰማም።

verses.en: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.
verses.fr: Il parcourt les montagnes pour trouver sa pâture, Il est à la recherche de tout ce qui est vert.
verses.am: ተራራውን እንደ መሰምርያው ይመለከተዋል፥  ለምለሙንም ሁሉ ይፈልጋል።

verses.en: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?
verses.fr: Le buffle veut-il être à ton service? Passe-t-il la nuit vers ta crèche?
verses.am: ጐሽ ያገለግልህ ዘንድ ይታዘዛልን?  ወይስ በግርግምህ አጠገብ ያድራልን?

verses.en: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
verses.fr: L''attaches-tu par une corde pour qu''il trace un sillon? Va-t-il après toi briser les mottes des vallées?
verses.am: ጐሽ ይተልምልህ ዘንድ ትጠምደዋለህን?  ወይስ ከአንተ በኋላ በእርሻ ላይ ይጐለጕላልን?

verses.en: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
verses.fr: Te reposes-tu sur lui, parce que sa force est grande? Lui abandonnes-tu le soin de tes travaux?
verses.am: ጕልበቱስ ብርቱ ስለ ሆነ ትታመነዋለህን?  ተግባርህንስ ለእርሱ ትተዋለህን?

verses.en: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?
verses.fr: Te fies-tu à lui pour la rentrée de ta récolte? Est-ce lui qui doit l''amasser dans ton aire?
verses.am: ዘርህንስ ይመልስልህ ዘንድ፥  በአውድማህስ ያከማችልህ ዘንድ ትታመነዋለህን?

verses.en: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
verses.fr: L''aile de l''autruche se déploie joyeuse; On dirait l''aile, le plumage de la cigogne.
verses.am: የሰጐን ክንፍ በደስታ ይንቀሳቀሳል፤  ነገር ግን ክንፉና ላባው ጭምተኛ ነውን?

verses.en: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,
verses.fr: Mais l''autruche abandonne ses oeufs à la terre, Et les fait chauffer sur la poussière;
verses.am: እንቍላልዋን በመሬት ላይ ትተዋለች፥  በአፈርም ውስጥ ታሞቀዋለች፤

verses.en: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
verses.fr: Elle oublie que le pied peut les écraser, Qu''une bête des champs peut les fouler.
verses.am: እግር ይሰብረው ዘንድ፥  የምድረ በዳም አውሬ ይረግጠው ዘንድ ትረሳለች።

verses.en: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not her's: her labour is in vain without fear;
verses.fr: Elle est dure envers ses petits comme s''ils n''étaient point à elle; Elle ne s''inquiète pas de l''inutilité de son enfantement.
verses.am: የእርስዋ እንዳልሆኑ በልጆችዋ ትጨክናለች።  በከንቱም ብትሠራ አትፈራም፤

verses.en: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
verses.fr: Car Dieu lui a refusé la sagesse, Il ne lui a pas donné l''intelligence en partage.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ጥበብን ከእርስዋ ከልክሎአልና፥  ማስተዋልንም አልሰጣትምና።

verses.en: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.
verses.fr: Quand elle se lève et prend sa course, Elle se rit du cheval et de son cavalier.
verses.am: ወደ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ስትል  በፈረስና በፈረሰኛው ትሳለቃለች።

verses.en: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?
verses.fr: Est-ce toi qui donnes la vigueur au cheval, Et qui revêts son cou d''une crinière flottante?
verses.am: ለፈረስ ጕልበቱን ሰጥተኸዋልን?  አንገቱንስ ጋማ አልብሰኸዋልን?

verses.en: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.
verses.fr: Le fais-tu bondir comme la sauterelle? Son fier hennissement répand la terreur.
verses.am: እንደ አንበጣስ አፈናጠርኸውን?  የማንኰራፋቱ ክብር የሚያስፈራ ነው።

verses.en: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.
verses.fr: Il creuse le sol et se réjouit de sa force, Il s''élance au-devant des armes;
verses.am: በኮቴው በሸለቆው ውስጥ ይጐደፍራል፥  በጉልበቱም ደስ ይለዋል፤  ሰይፍም የታጠቁትን ለመገናኘት ይወጣል።

verses.en: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.
verses.fr: Il se rit de la crainte, il n''a pas peur, Il ne recule pas en face de l''épée.
verses.am: በፍርሃት ላይ ይስቃል፥  እርሱም አይደነግጥም፤  ከሰይፍም ፊት አይመለስም።

verses.en: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
verses.fr: Sur lui retentit le carquois, Brillent la lance et le javelot.
verses.am: በእርሱ ላይ የፍላጻ ኮረጆና ብልጭልጭ የሚል ጦር  ሰላጢንም ያንኳኳሉ።

verses.en: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.
verses.fr: Bouillonnant d''ardeur, il dévore la terre, Il ne peut se contenir au bruit de la trompette.
verses.am: በጭካኔና በቍጣ መሬትን ይውጣል፤  የመለከትም ድምፅ ቢሰማ አይቆምም።

verses.en: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
verses.fr: Quand la trompette sonne, il dit: En avant! Et de loin il flaire la bataille, La voix tonnante des chefs et les cris de guerre.
verses.am: የመለከትም ድምፅ ሲሰማ። እሰይ! ይላል፤  ከሩቅ ሆኖ ሰልፍንና የአለቆቹን ጩኸት፥  የሠራዊቱንም ውካታ ያሸታል።

verses.en: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?
verses.fr: Est-ce par ton intelligence que l''épervier prend son vol, Et qu''il étend ses ailes vers le midi?
verses.am: በውኑ ከጥበብህ የተነሣ ጭልፊት ያንዣብባልን?  ወይስ ክንፎቹን ወደ ደቡብ ይዘረጋልን?

verses.en: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?
verses.fr: Est-ce par ton ordre que l''aigle s''élève, Et qu''il place son nid sur les hauteurs?
verses.am: በአፍህ ትእዛዝ ንስር ከፍ ከፍ ይላልን?  ቤቱንስ በአርያም ላይ ያደርጋልን?

verses.en: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
verses.fr: C''est dans les rochers qu''il habite, qu''il a sa demeure, Sur la cime des rochers, sur le sommet des monts.
verses.am: በገደል ላይ ይኖራል፤  በገደሉ ገመገምና በጥጉ ያድራል።

verses.en: From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.
verses.fr: De là il épie sa proie, Il plonge au loin les regards.
verses.am: በዚያም ሆኖ የሚነጥቀውን ይጐበኛል፤  ዓይኑም በሩቅ ትመለከታለች።

verses.en: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.
verses.fr: Ses petits boivent le sang; Et là où sont des cadavres, l''aigle se trouve.
verses.am: ጫጩቶቹም ደም ይጠጣሉ፤  በድን ባለባትም ስፍራ እርሱ በዚያ አለ።

verses.en: Moreover the Lord answered Job, and said,
verses.fr: L''Eternel, s''adressant à Job, dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም መለሰ ኢዮብንም እንዲህ አለው።

verses.en: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.
verses.fr: Celui qui dispute contre le Tout-Puissant est-il convaincu? Celui qui conteste avec Dieu a-t-il une réplique à faire?
verses.am: በውኑ የሚከራከር ሰው ሁሉን ከሚችል አምላክ ጋር ይከራከራልን?  ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር የሚዋቀስ እርሱ ይመልስለት።

verses.en: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,
verses.fr: Job répondit à l''Eternel et dit:
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እግዚአብሔርንም እንዲህ አለው።

verses.en: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
verses.fr: Voici, je suis trop peu de chose; que te répliquerais-je? Je mets la main sur ma bouche.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ ወራዳ ሰው ነኝ፤ የምመልስልህ ምንድር ነው?  እጄን በአፌ ላይ እጭናለሁ።

verses.en: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
verses.fr: J''ai parlé une fois, je ne répondrai plus; Deux fois, je n''ajouterai rien.
verses.am: አንድ ጊዜ ተናገርሁ፥ አልመልስምም፤  ሁለተኛ ጊዜም፥ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አልናገርም።

verses.en: Then answered the Lord unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.fr: L''Eternel répondit à Job du milieu de la tempête et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በዐውሎ ነፋስ ውስጥ ሆኖ ለኢዮብ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.fr: Ceins tes reins comme un vaillant homme; Je t''interrogerai, et tu m''instruiras.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንደ ወንድ ወገብህን ታጠቅ፤  እጠይቅሃለሁ፥ አንተም ተናገረኝ።

verses.en: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
verses.fr: Anéantiras-tu jusqu''à ma justice? Me condamneras-tu pour te donner droit?
verses.am: በውኑ ፍርዴን ታፈርሳለህን?  አንተስ ጻድቅ ትሆን ዘንድ በእኔ ትፈርዳለህን?

verses.en: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
verses.fr: As-tu un bras comme celui de Dieu, Une voix tonnante comme la sienne?
verses.am: እንደ እግዚአብሔር ክንድ ያለ ክንድ አለህን?  ወይስ እንደ እርሱ ባለ ድምፅ ታንጐደጕዳለህን?

verses.en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
verses.fr: Orne-toi de magnificence et de grandeur, Revêts-toi de splendeur et de gloire!
verses.am: በታላቅነትና በልዕልና ተላበስ፤  በክብርና በግርማም ተጐናጸፍ።

verses.en: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.
verses.fr: Répands les flots de ta colère, Et d''un regard abaisse les hautains!
verses.am: የቍጣህን ፈሳሽ አፍስስ፤  ትዕቢተኛውንም ሁሉ ተመልክተህ አዋርደው።

verses.en: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
verses.fr: D''un regard humilie les hautains, Ecrase sur place les méchants,
verses.am: ትዕቢተኛውንም ሁሉ ተመልከት፥ ዝቅ ዝቅም አድርገው፤  በደለኞችንም ወዲያውኑ እርገጣቸው።

verses.en: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.
verses.fr: Cache-les tous ensemble dans la poussière, Enferme leur front dans les ténèbres!
verses.am: በአፈር ውስጥ በአንድነት ሰውራቸው፤  በተሸሸገም ስፍራ ፊታቸውን ሸፍን።

verses.en: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.
verses.fr: Alors je rends hommage A la puissance de ta droite.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ቀኝ እጅህ ታድንህ ዘንድ እንድትችል  እኔ ደግሞ እመሰክርልሃለሁ።

verses.en: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
verses.fr: Voici l''hippopotame, à qui j''ai donné la vie comme à toi! Il mange de l''herbe comme le boeuf.
verses.am: ከአንተ ጋር የሠራሁትን ጉማሬ፥ እስኪ፥ ተመልከት፤  እንደ በሬ ሣር ይበላል።

verses.en: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.
verses.fr: Le voici! Sa force est dans ses reins, Et sa vigueur dans les muscles de son ventre;
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ብርታቱ በወገቡ ውስጥ ነው፤  ኃይሉም በሆዱ ጅማት ውስጥ ነው።

verses.en: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
verses.fr: Il plie sa queue aussi ferme qu''un cèdre; Les nerfs de ses cuisses sont entrelacés;
verses.am: ጅራቱን እንደ ጥድ ዛፍ ያወዛውዛል፤  የወርቹ ጅማት የተጐነጐነ ነው።

verses.en: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.
verses.fr: Ses os sont des tubes d''airain, Ses membres sont comme des barres de fer.
verses.am: አጥንቱ እንደ ናስ አገዳ ነው፤  አካላቱ እንደ ብረት ዘንጎች ናቸው።

verses.en: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.
verses.fr: Il est la première des oeuvres de Dieu; Celui qui l''a fait l''a pourvu d''un glaive.
verses.am: እርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ፍጥረት አውራ ነው፤  ሠሪውም ሰይፉን ሰጠው።

verses.en: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
verses.fr: Il trouve sa pâture dans les montagnes, Où se jouent toutes les bêtes des champs.
verses.am: የሜዳ እንስሶች ሁሉ የሚጫወቱበት ተራራ  ምግብን ያበቅልለታል።

verses.en: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
verses.fr: Il se couche sous les lotus, Au milieu des roseaux et des marécages;
verses.am: ጥላ ካለው ዛፍ በታች፥  በደንገልና በረግረግ ውስጥ ይተኛል።

verses.en: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
verses.fr: Les lotus le couvrent de leur ombre, Les saules du torrent l''environnent.
verses.am: ጥላ ያለው ዛፍ በጥላው ይሰውረዋል፤  የወንዝ አኻያ ዛፎች ይከብቡታል።

verses.en: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
verses.fr: Que le fleuve vienne à déborder, il ne s''enfuit pas: Que le Jourdain se précipite dans sa gueule, il reste calme.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ወንዙ ቢጐርፍ አይደነግጥም፤  ዮርዳኖስም እስከ አፉ ድረስ ቢፈስስ እርሱ ይተማመናል።

verses.en: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.
verses.fr: Est-ce à force ouverte qu''on pourra le saisir? Est-ce au moyen de filets qu''on lui percera le nez?
verses.am: ዓይኖቹ እያዩ ይያዛልን?  አፍንጫውስ በወጥመድ ይበሳልን?

verses.en: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
verses.fr: Prendras-tu le crocodile à l''hameçon? Saisiras-tu sa langue avec une corde?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ተስፋው ከንቱ ነው፤  ያየው ሁሉ ስንኳ በፊቱ ይዋረዳል።

verses.en: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
verses.fr: Mettras-tu un jonc dans ses narines? Lui perceras-tu la mâchoire avec un crochet?
verses.am: ያንቀሳቅሰውም ዘንድ የሚደፍር የለም፤  እንግዲህ በፊቴ መቆም የሚችል ማን ነው?

verses.en: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?
verses.fr: Te pressera-t-il de supplication? Te parlera-t-il d''une voix douce?
verses.am: እመልስለትስ ዘንድ መጀመሪያ የሰጠኝ ማን ነው?  ከሰማይ ሁሉ በታች ያለው ገንዘቤ ነው።

verses.en: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
verses.fr: Fera-t-il une alliance avec toi, Pour devenir à toujours ton esclave?
verses.am: ስለ አካላቱና ስለ ብርቱ ኃይሉ፥  ስለ መልካም ሰውነቱ ዝም አልልም።

verses.en: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
verses.fr: Joueras-tu avec lui comme avec un oiseau? L''attacheras-tu pour amuser tes jeunes filles?
verses.am: የውጪ ልብሱን ማን ይገፋል?  በጥንድ መንጋጋውስ ውስጥ ማን ይገባል?

verses.en: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
verses.fr: Les pêcheurs en trafiquent-ils? Le partagent-ils entre les marchands?
verses.am: የፊቱንስ ደጆች የሚከፍት ማን ነው?  በጥርሶቹ ዙሪያ ግርማ አለ።

verses.en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
verses.fr: Couvriras-tu sa peau de dards, Et sa tête de harpons?
verses.am: ቅርፊቶቹ ጠንካራ ስለ ሆኑ እርሱ ትዕቢተኛ ነው፤  በጠባብ ማተሚያ እንደ ታተሙ ናቸው።

verses.en: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
verses.fr: Dresse ta main contre lui, Et tu ne t''aviseras plus de l''attaquer.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸው የተቀራረቡ ናቸውና  ነፋስ በመካከላቸው መግባት አይችልም።

verses.en: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.fr: Voici, on est trompé dans son attente; A son seul aspect n''est-on pas terrassé?
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸው የተገጣጠሙ ናቸው፤  እስከማይለያዩም ድረስ ተያይዘዋል።

verses.en: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
verses.fr: Nul n''est assez hardi pour l''exciter; Qui donc me résisterait en face?
verses.am: እንጥሽታው ብልጭታ ያወጣል፥  ዓይኖቹም እንደ ወገግታ ናቸው።

verses.en: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
verses.fr: De qui suis-je le débiteur? Je le paierai. Sous le ciel tout m''appartient.
verses.am: ከአፉ ፋናዎች ይወጣሉ፥  የእሳትም ፍንጣሪ ይረጫል።

verses.en: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
verses.fr: Je veux encore parler de ses membres, Et de sa force, et de la beauté de sa structure.
verses.am: እንደ ፈላ ድስትና እንደሚቃጠል ሸምበቆ  ከአንፍንጫው ጢስ ይወጣል።

verses.en: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?
verses.fr: Qui soulèvera son vêtement? Qui pénétrera entre ses mâchoires?
verses.am: እስትንፋሱ ከሰልን ታቃጥላለች፥  ነበልባልም ከአፉ ይወጣል።

verses.en: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.
verses.fr: Qui ouvrira les portes de sa gueule? Autour de ses dents habite la terreur.
verses.am: በአንገቱ ኃይል ታድራለች፤  ግርማ በፊቱ ይዘፍናል።

verses.en: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
verses.fr: Ses magnifiques et puissants boucliers Sont unis ensemble comme par un sceau;
verses.am: የሥጋውም ቅርፊት የተጣበቀ ነው፤  እስከማይንቀሳቀሱም ድረስ በእርሱ ላይ ጸንተዋል።

verses.en: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
verses.fr: Ils se serrent l''un contre l''autre, Et l''air ne passerait pas entre eux;
verses.am: ልቡ እንደ ድንጋይ የደነደነ ነው፤  እንደ ወፍጮ ድንጋይ የጸና ነው።

verses.en: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
verses.fr: Ce sont des frères qui s''embrassent, Se saisissent, demeurent inséparables.
verses.am: በተነሣ ጊዜ ኃያላን ይፈራሉ፤  ከድንጋጤም የተነሣ ያብዳሉ።

verses.en: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.fr: Ses éternuements font briller la lumière; Ses yeux sont comme les paupières de l''aurore.
verses.am: ሰይፍና ጦር፥ ፍላጻና መውጊያም ቢያገኙት አያሸንፉትም።

verses.en: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
verses.fr: Des flammes jaillissent de sa bouche, Des étincelles de feu s''en échappent.
verses.am: ብረትን እንደ ገለባ፥  ናስንም እንደ ነቀዘ እንጨት ይቈጥራቸዋል።

verses.en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
verses.fr: Une fumée sort de ses narines, Comme d''un vase qui bout, d''une chaudière ardente.
verses.am: ፍላጻ ሊያባርረው አይችልም፤  የወንጭፍም ድንጋዮች እንደ ገለባ ይሆኑለታል።

verses.en: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
verses.fr: Son souffle allume les charbons, Sa gueule lance la flamme.
verses.am: በሎታውን እንደ ገለባ ይቈጥረዋል፤  ሰላጢኑም ሲሰበቅ ይስቃል።

verses.en: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
verses.fr: La force a son cou pour demeure, Et l''effroi bondit au-devant de lui.
verses.am: ታቹ እንደ ስለታም ገል ነው፤  እንደ መዳመጫም በጭቃ ላይ ያልፋል።

verses.en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
verses.fr: Ses parties charnues tiennent ensemble, Fondues sur lui, inébranlables.
verses.am: ቀላዩን እንደ ድስት ያፈላዋል፤  ባሕሩንም እንደ ሽቱ ምንቸት ያደርገዋል።

verses.en: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.
verses.fr: Son coeur est dur comme la pierre, Dur comme la meule inférieure.
verses.am: በስተ ኋላው ብሩህ መንገድን ያበራል፤  ቀላዩም ሽበት ይመስላል።

verses.en: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
verses.fr: Quand il se lève, les plus vaillants ont peur, Et l''épouvante les fait fuir.
verses.am: ያለ ፍርሃት የተፈጠረ፥  እንደ እርሱ ያለ በምድር ላይ የለም።

verses.en: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
verses.fr: C''est en vain qu''on l''attaque avec l''épée; La lance, le javelot, la cuirasse, ne servent à rien.
verses.am: ከፍ ያለውን ሁሉ ይመለከታል፤  በትዕቢተኞችም ሁሉ ላይ ንጉሥ ነው።

verses.en: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
verses.fr: Il regarde le fer comme de la paille, L''airain comme du bois pourri.

verses.en: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
verses.fr: La flèche ne le met pas en fuite, Les pierres de la fronde sont pour lui du chaume.

verses.en: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
verses.fr: Il ne voit dans la massue qu''un brin de paille, Il rit au sifflement des dards.

verses.en: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
verses.fr: Sous son ventre sont des pointes aiguës: On dirait une herse qu''il étend sur le limon.

verses.en: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.fr: Il fait bouillir le fond de la mer comme une chaudière, Il l''agite comme un vase rempli de parfums.

verses.en: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
verses.fr: Il laisse après lui un sentier lumineux; L''abîme prend la chevelure d''un vieillard.

verses.en: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
verses.fr: Sur la terre nul n''est son maître; Il a été créé pour ne rien craindre.

verses.en: He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.
verses.fr: Il regarde avec dédain tout ce qui est élevé, Il est le roi des plus fiers animaux.

verses.en: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,
verses.fr: Job répondit à l''Eternel et dit:
verses.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እግዚአብሔርንም እንዲህ አለው።

verses.en: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
verses.fr: Je reconnais que tu peux tout, Et que rien ne s''oppose à tes pensées.
verses.am: ሁሉን ታደርግ ዘንድ ቻይ እንደ ሆንህ፥  አሳብህም ይከለከል ዘንድ ከቶ እንደማይቻል አወቅሁ።

verses.en: Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
verses.fr: Quel est celui qui a la folie d''obscurcir mes desseins? -Oui, j''ai parlé, sans les comprendre, De merveilles qui me dépassent et que je ne conçois pas.
verses.am: ያለ እውቀት ምክርን የሚሰውር ማን ነው?  ስለዚህ እኔ የማላስተውለውን፥  የማላውቀውንም ድንቅ ነገር ተናግሬአለሁ።

verses.en: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.fr: Ecoute-moi, et je parlerai; Je t''interrogerai, et tu m''instruiras.
verses.am: እባክህ፥ ስማኝ እኔም ልናገር፤  እጠይቅህማለሁ፥ አንተም ተናገረኝ።

verses.en: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.
verses.fr: Mon oreille avait entendu parler de toi; Mais maintenant mon oeil t''a vu.
verses.am: መስማትንስ በጆሮ በመስማት ሰምቼ ነበር፤  አሁን ግን ዓይኔ አየችህ፤

verses.en: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi je me condamne et je me repens Sur la poussière et sur la cendre.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ራሴን እንቃለሁ፤  በአፈርና በአመድ ላይ ተቀምጬ እጸጸታለሁ።

verses.en: And it was so, that after the Lord had spoken these words unto Job, the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.
verses.fr: Après que l''Eternel eut adressé ces paroles à Job, il dit à Eliphaz de Théman: Ma colère est enflammée contre toi et contre tes deux amis, parce que vous n''avez pas parlé de moi avec droiture comme l''a fait mon serviteur Job.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ይህን ቃል ለኢዮብ ከተናገረ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ቴማናዊውን ኤልፋዝን። እንደ ባሪያዬ እንደ ኢዮብ ቅንን ነገር ስለ እኔ አልተናገራችሁምና ቍጣዬ በአንተና በሁለቱ ባልንጀሮችህ ላይ ነድዶአል።

verses.en: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.
verses.fr: Prenez maintenant sept taureaux et sept béliers, allez auprès de mon serviteur Job, et offrez pour vous un holocauste. Job, mon serviteur, priera pour vous, et c''est par égard pour lui seul que je ne vous traiterai pas selon votre folie; car vous n''avez pas parlé de moi avec droiture, comme l''a fait mon serviteur Job.
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ ሰባት ወይፈኖችና ሰባት አውራ በጎች ይዛችሁ ወደ ባሪያዬ ወደ ኢዮብ ዘንድ ሂዱ፥ የሚቃጠልንም መሥዋዕት ስለ ራሳችሁ አሳርጉ፤ ባሪያዬም ኢዮብ ስለ እናንተ ይጸልያል፥ እኔም እንደ ስንፍናችሁ እንዳላደርግባችሁ ፊቱን እቀበላለሁ፤ እንደ ባሪያዬ እንደ ኢዮብ ቅን ነገር ስለ እኔ አልተናገራችሁምና።

verses.en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the Lord commanded them: the Lord also accepted Job.
verses.fr: Eliphaz de Théman, Bildad de Schuach, et Tsophar de Naama allèrent et firent comme l''Eternel leur avait dit: et l''Eternel eut égard à la prière de Job.
verses.am: ቴማናዊውም ኤልፋዝ ሹሐዊውም በልዳዶስ ናዕማታዊውም ሶፋር ሄደው እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዛቸው አደረጉ እግዚአብሔርም የኢዮብን ፊት ተቀበለ።

verses.en: And the Lord turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.fr: L''Eternel rétablit Job dans son premier état, quand Job eut prié pour ses amis; et l''Eternel lui accorda le double de tout ce qu''il avait possédé.
verses.am: ኢዮብም ስለ ወዳጆቹ በጸለየ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርም ምርኮውን መለሰለት፤ እግዚአብሔርም ቀድሞ በነበረው ፋንታ ሁለት እጥፍ አድርጎ ለኢዮብ ሰጠው።

verses.en: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the Lord had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.
verses.fr: Les frères, les soeurs, et les anciens amis de Job vinrent tous le visiter, et ils mangèrent avec lui dans sa maison. Ils le plaignirent et le consolèrent de tous les malheurs que l''Eternel avait fait venir sur lui, et chacun lui donna un kesita et un anneau d''or.
verses.am: ወንድሞቹና እኅቶቹ ቀድሞም ያውቁት የነበሩት ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ መጡ፥ በቤቱም ከእርሱ ጋር እንጀራ በሉ፤ ስለ እርሱም አዘኑለት፥ እግዚአብሔርም ካመጣበት ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ አጽናኑት፤ እያንዳንዳቸውም ብርና የወርቅ ቀለበት ሰጡት።

verses.en: So the Lord blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
verses.fr: Pendant ses dernières années, Job reçut de l''Eternel plus de bénédictions qu''il n''en avait reçu dans les premières. Il posséda quatorze mille brebis, six mille chameaux, mille paires de boeufs, et mille ânesses.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከፊተኛው ይልቅ የኋለኛውን ለኢዮብ ባረከ፤ አሥራ አራት ሺህም በጎች፥ ስድስት ሺህም ግመሎች፥ አንድ ሺህም ጥማድ በሬዎች፥ አንድ ሺህም እንስት አህዮች ነበሩት።

verses.en: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.fr: Il eut sept fils et trois filles:
verses.am: ደግሞም ሰባት ወንዶችና ሦስት ሴቶች ልጆች ሆኑለት።

verses.en: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Kerenhappuch.
verses.fr: il donna à la première le nom de Jemima, à la seconde celui de Ketsia, et à la troisième celui de Kéren-Happuc.
verses.am: የመጀመሪያይቱንም ስም ይሚማ፥ የሁለተኛይቱንም ስም ቃስያ፥ የሦስተኛይቱንም ስም አማልቶያስ ቂራስ ብሎ ሰየማቸው።

verses.en: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
verses.fr: Il n''y avait pas dans tout le pays d''aussi belles femmes que les filles de Job. Leur père leur accorda une part d''héritage parmi leurs frères.
verses.am: እንደ ኢዮብ ሴቶች ልጆችም ያሉ የተዋቡ ሴቶች በአገሩ ሁሉ አልተገኙም፤ አባታቸውም ከወንድሞቻቸው ጋር ርስት ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.
verses.fr: Job vécut après cela cent quarante ans, et il vit ses fils et les fils de ses fils jusqu''à la quatrième génération.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ኢዮብ መቶ አርባ ዓመት ኖረ፥ ልጆቹንና የልጅ ልጆቹንም እስከ አራት ተውልድ ድረስ አየ።

verses.en: So Job died, being old and full of days.
verses.fr: Et Job mourut âgé et rassasié de jours.
verses.am: ኢዮብም ሸምግሎ ዕድሜም ጠግቦ ሞተ።
